verses.kjv: The Revelation of Jesus Christ, which God gave unto him, to shew unto his servants things which must shortly come to pass; and he sent and signified it by his angel unto his servant John:
verses.modern: This is the Revelation of Jesus Christ. God gave it to Him to show His servants what must soon take place. He sent it through His angel to His servant John.

verses.kjv: Who bare record of the word of God, and of the testimony of Jesus Christ, and of all things that he saw.
verses.modern: John testified to the word of God and to the testimony of Jesus Christ — everything He saw.

verses.kjv: Blessed is he that readeth, and they that hear the words of this prophecy, and keep those things which are written therein: for the time is at hand.
verses.modern: Blessed is the one who reads, and blessed are those who hear the words of this prophecy and keep what is written in it. The time is near.

verses.kjv: John to the seven churches which are in Asia: Grace be unto you, and peace, from him which is, and which was, and which is to come; and from the seven Spirits which are before his throne;
verses.modern: John to the seven churches in Asia: Grace and peace to You from Him who is, and who was, and who is to come — and from the seven Spirits before His throne.

verses.kjv: And from Jesus Christ, who is the faithful witness, and the first begotten of the dead, and the prince of the kings of the earth. Unto him that loved us, and washed us from our sins in his own blood,
verses.modern: And from Jesus Christ — the faithful witness, the firstborn from the dead, the ruler of the kings of the earth. To Him who loved us and washed us from our sins in His own blood.

verses.kjv: And hath made us kings and priests unto God and his Father; to him be glory and dominion for ever and ever. Amen.
verses.modern: He has made us kings and priests to God His Father. To Him be glory and dominion for ever and ever. Amen.

verses.kjv: Behold, he cometh with clouds; and every eye shall see him, and they also which pierced him: and all kindreds of the earth shall wail because of him. Even so, Amen.
verses.modern: He is coming with clouds, and every eye will see Him — even those who pierced Him. All families of the earth will mourn because of Him. Even so, Amen.

verses.kjv: I am Alpha and Omega, the beginning and the ending, saith the Lord, which is, and which was, and which is to come, the Almighty.
verses.modern: "I am Alpha and Omega, the beginning and the ending," says the Lord, who is and who was and who is to come — the Almighty.

verses.kjv: I John, who also am your brother, and companion in tribulation, and in the kingdom and patience of Jesus Christ, was in the isle that is called Patmos, for the word of God, and for the testimony of Jesus Christ.
verses.modern: I, John, am your brother and partner in the suffering and kingdom and patient endurance that are in Jesus Christ. I was on the island called Patmos because of the word of God and the testimony of Jesus Christ.

verses.kjv: I was in the Spirit on the Lord's day, and heard behind me a great voice, as of a trumpet,
verses.modern: I was in the Spirit on the Lord's day. I heard behind me a loud voice like a trumpet.

verses.kjv: Saying, I am Alpha and Omega, the first and the last: and, What thou seest, write in a book, and send it unto the seven churches which are in Asia; unto Ephesus, and unto Smyrna, and unto Pergamos, and unto Thyatira, and unto Sardis, and unto Philadelphia, and unto Laodicea.
verses.modern: It said, "I am Alpha and Omega, the first and the last." Then it said, "Write in a book what You see, and send it to the seven churches — to Ephesus, Smyrna, Pergamos, Thyatira, Sardis, Philadelphia, and Laodicea."

verses.kjv: And I turned to see the voice that spake with me. And being turned, I saw seven golden candlesticks;
verses.modern: I turned to see the voice that spoke to me. When I turned, I saw seven golden lampstands.

verses.kjv: And in the midst of the seven candlesticks one like unto the Son of man, clothed with a garment down to the foot, and girt about the paps with a golden girdle.
verses.modern: In the middle of the lampstands stood one like the Son of Man. He was clothed with a robe reaching to His feet, and a golden sash was wrapped around His chest.

verses.kjv: His head and his hairs were white like wool, as white as snow; and his eyes were as a flame of fire;
verses.modern: His head and hair were white as wool — as white as snow. His eyes were like a flame of fire.

verses.kjv: And his feet like unto fine brass, as if they burned in a furnace; and his voice as the sound of many waters.
verses.modern: His feet were like polished bronze, glowing as if refined in a furnace. His voice was like the sound of many waters.

verses.kjv: And he had in his right hand seven stars: and out of his mouth went a sharp twoedged sword: and his countenance was as the sun shineth in his strength.
verses.modern: In His right hand He held seven stars. Out of His mouth came a sharp two-edged sword. His countenance was like the sun shining in full strength.

verses.kjv: And when I saw him, I fell at his feet as dead. And he laid his right hand upon me, saying unto me, Fear not; I am the first and the last:
verses.modern: When I saw Him, I fell at His feet as though dead. He laid His right hand on me and said, "Do not be afraid. I am the first and the last."

verses.kjv: I am he that liveth, and was dead; and, behold, I am alive for evermore, Amen; and have the keys of hell and of death.
verses.modern: "I am the Living One. I was dead, and now I am alive for ever and ever. Amen. I hold the keys of hell and of death."

verses.kjv: Write the things which thou hast seen, and the things which are, and the things which shall be hereafter;
verses.modern: "Write the things You have seen, the things that are, and the things that will take place after this."

verses.kjv: The mystery of the seven stars which thou sawest in my right hand, and the seven golden candlesticks. The seven stars are the angels of the seven churches: and the seven candlesticks which thou sawest are the seven churches.
verses.modern: "Here is the mystery of the seven stars You saw in My right hand and the seven golden lampstands: the seven stars are the angels of the seven churches, and the seven lampstands are the seven churches."

chapters.summary: John receives the Revelation of Jesus Christ on the island of Patmos and is commanded to write what he sees to the seven churches in Asia. He sees the Son of man standing among seven golden candlesticks, clothed in a garment down to the foot, His countenance like the sun shining in its strength, holding seven stars in His right hand.

verses.kjv: Unto the angel of the church of Ephesus write; These things saith he that holdeth the seven stars in his right hand, who walketh in the midst of the seven golden candlesticks;
verses.modern: "To the angel of the church in Ephesus write: These things are said by the One who holds the seven stars in his right hand, who walks among the seven golden lampstands."

verses.kjv: I know thy works, and thy labour, and thy patience, and how thou canst not bear them which are evil: and thou hast tried them which say they are apostles, and are not, and hast found them liars:
verses.modern: "I know Your works, Your labor, and Your patient endurance. I know You cannot tolerate evil men. You have tested those who call themselves apostles and are not, and You found them to be liars."

verses.kjv: And hast borne, and hast patience, and for my name's sake hast laboured, and hast not fainted.
verses.modern: "You have endured and had patience, and for My name's sake You have labored and not grown weary."

verses.kjv: Nevertheless I have somewhat against thee, because thou hast left thy first love.
verses.modern: "But I have this against You: You have left Your first love."

verses.kjv: Remember therefore from whence thou art fallen, and repent, and do the first works; or else I will come unto thee quickly, and will remove thy candlestick out of his place, except thou repent.
verses.modern: "Remember from where You have fallen. Repent and do the works You did at first. If not, I will come to You and remove Your lampstand from its place — unless You repent."

verses.kjv: But this thou hast, that thou hatest the deeds of the Nicolaitanes, which I also hate.
verses.modern: "But You have this in Your favor: You hate the deeds of the Nicolaitans, which I also hate."

verses.kjv: He that hath an ear, let him hear what the Spirit saith unto the churches; To him that overcometh will I give to eat of the tree of life, which is in the midst of the paradise of God.
verses.modern: "Let the one who has an ear listen to what the Spirit says to the churches. To the one who overcomes I will give the right to eat from the tree of life, which is in the paradise of God."

verses.kjv: And unto the angel of the church in Smyrna write; These things saith the first and the last, which was dead, and is alive;
verses.modern: "To the angel of the church in Smyrna write: These things are said by the First and the Last, who was dead and came to life."

verses.kjv: I know thy works, and tribulation, and poverty, (but thou art rich) and I know the blasphemy of them which say they are Jews, and are not, but are the synagogue of Satan.
verses.modern: "I know your works, your tribulation, and your poverty — but you are rich. I know the slander of those who say they are Jews but are not, and are the synagogue of Satan."

verses.kjv: Fear none of those things which thou shalt suffer: behold, the devil shall cast some of you into prison, that ye may be tried; and ye shall have tribulation ten days: be thou faithful unto death, and I will give thee a crown of life.
verses.modern: "Do not be afraid of what you are about to suffer. The devil is about to throw some of you into prison to test you, and you will have tribulation for ten days. Be faithful to death, and I will give you the crown of life."

verses.kjv: He that hath an ear, let him hear what the Spirit saith unto the churches; He that overcometh shall not be hurt of the second death.
verses.modern: "Let the one who has an ear listen to what the Spirit says to the churches. The one who overcomes will not be hurt by the second death."

verses.kjv: And to the angel of the church in Pergamos write; These things saith he which hath the sharp sword with two edges;
verses.modern: "To the angel of the church in Pergamos write: These things are said by the One who has the sharp two-edged sword."

verses.kjv: I know thy works, and where thou dwellest, even where Satan's seat is: and thou holdest fast my name, and hast not denied my faith, even in those days wherein Antipas was my faithful martyr, who was slain among you, where Satan dwelleth.
verses.modern: "I know your works and where you live — where Satan's throne is. You hold fast to My name and have not denied My faith, even in the days of Antipas, My faithful martyr, who was killed among you where Satan lives."

verses.kjv: But I have a few things against thee, because thou hast there them that hold the doctrine of Balaam, who taught Balac to cast a stumblingblock before the children of Israel, to eat things sacrificed unto idols, and to commit fornication.
verses.modern: "But I have a few things against you: you have some there who hold to the teaching of Balaam, who taught Balak to put a stumbling block before the children of Israel — to eat food sacrificed to idols and to commit fornication."

verses.kjv: So hast thou also them that hold the doctrine of the Nicolaitanes, which thing I hate.
verses.modern: "You also have some who hold to the teaching of the Nicolaitans in the same way — which I hate."

verses.kjv: Repent; or else I will come unto thee quickly, and will fight against them with the sword of my mouth.
verses.modern: "Repent. If not, I will come to you quickly and fight against them with the sword of My mouth."

verses.kjv: He that hath an ear, let him hear what the Spirit saith unto the churches; To him that overcometh will I give to eat of the hidden manna, and will give him a white stone, and in the stone a new name written, which no man knoweth saving he that receiveth it.
verses.modern: "Let the one who has an ear listen to what the Spirit says to the churches. To the one who overcomes I will give the hidden manna. I will also give Him a white stone, with a new name written on it that no one knows except the one who receives it."

verses.kjv: And unto the angel of the church in Thyatira write; These things saith the Son of God, who hath his eyes like unto a flame of fire, and his feet are like fine brass;
verses.modern: "To the angel of the church in Thyatira write: These things are said by the Son of God, Who has eyes like a flame of fire and feet like polished bronze."

verses.kjv: I know thy works, and charity, and service, and faith, and thy patience, and thy works; and the last to be more than the first.
verses.modern: "I know Your works — your love, Your service, Your faith, and Your patient endurance. I know that Your latter works exceed the first."

verses.kjv: Notwithstanding I have a few things against thee, because thou sufferest that woman Jezebel, which calleth herself a prophetess, to teach and to seduce my servants to commit fornication, and to eat things sacrificed unto idols.
verses.modern: "But I have this against you: you tolerate that woman Jezebel, who calls herself a prophetess, and she teaches and seduces My servants to commit fornication and to eat things sacrificed to idols."

verses.kjv: And I gave her space to repent of her fornication; and she repented not.
verses.modern: "I gave her time to repent, but she refuses to repent of her fornication."

verses.kjv: Behold, I will cast her into a bed, and them that commit adultery with her into great tribulation, except they repent of their deeds.
verses.modern: "I am going to throw her onto a bed of sickness, and those who commit adultery with her into great tribulation — unless they repent of her deeds."

verses.kjv: And I will kill her children with death; and all the churches shall know that I am he which searcheth the reins and hearts: and I will give unto every one of you according to your works.
verses.modern: "I will strike her children dead. Then all the churches will know that I am He who searches minds and hearts. I will give to each of you according to your works."

verses.kjv: But unto you I say, and unto the rest in Thyatira, as many as have not this doctrine, and which have not known the depths of Satan, as they speak; I will put upon you none other burden.
verses.modern: "But to the rest of you in Thyatira — all who do not hold this teaching and have not learned what they call 'the deep things of Satan' — I put no other burden on you."

verses.kjv: But that which ye have already hold fast till I come.
verses.modern: "Only hold fast to what you have until I come."

verses.kjv: And he that overcometh, and keepeth my works unto the end, to him will I give power over the nations:
verses.modern: "To the one who overcomes and keeps My works to the end, I will give authority over the nations."

verses.kjv: And he shall rule them with a rod of iron; as the vessels of a potter shall they be broken to shivers: even as I received of my Father.
verses.modern: "He will rule them with a rod of iron, as when clay pots are broken in pieces — just as I also received authority from My Father."

verses.kjv: And I will give him the morning star.
verses.modern: "And I will give him the morning star."

verses.kjv: He that hath an ear, let him hear what the Spirit saith unto the churches.
verses.modern: "Let the one who has an ear listen to what the Spirit says to the churches."

chapters.summary: Christ dictates letters to four churches: Ephesus, which has left its first love; Smyrna, which will suffer tribulation ten days but must be faithful unto death; Pergamos, which dwells where Satan's seat is but tolerates false teaching; and Thyatira, which suffers the woman Jezebel to teach and seduce His servants.

verses.kjv: And unto the angel of the church in Sardis write; These things saith he that hath the seven Spirits of God, and the seven stars; I know thy works, that thou hast a name that thou livest, and art dead.
verses.modern: "To the angel of the church in Sardis write: These things are said by the One who has the seven Spirits of God and the seven stars. I know Your works — you have a reputation for being alive, but You are dead."

verses.kjv: Be watchful, and strengthen the things which remain, that are ready to die: for I have not found thy works perfect before God.
verses.modern: "Wake up and strengthen what remains, which is about to die. I have not found Your works complete before My God."

verses.kjv: Remember therefore how thou hast received and heard, and hold fast, and repent. If therefore thou shalt not watch, I will come on thee as a thief, and thou shalt not know what hour I will come upon thee.
verses.modern: "Remember what You received and heard. Hold to it and repent. If You do not wake up, I will come like a thief, and You will not know at what hour I will come against You."

verses.kjv: Thou hast a few names even in Sardis which have not defiled their garments; and they shall walk with me in white: for they are worthy.
verses.modern: "Yet You have a few names in Sardis who have not defiled their clothes. They will walk with Me in white, for they are worthy."

verses.kjv: He that overcometh, the same shall be clothed in white raiment; and I will not blot out his name out of the book of life, but I will confess his name before my Father, and before his angels.
verses.modern: "The one who overcomes will be dressed in white. I will never blot out His name from the book of life. I will confess His name before My Father and before His angels."

verses.kjv: He that hath an ear, let him hear what the Spirit saith unto the churches.
verses.modern: "Let the one who has an ear listen to what the Spirit says to the churches."

verses.kjv: And to the angel of the church in Philadelphia write; These things saith he that is holy, he that is true, he that hath the key of David, he that openeth, and no man shutteth; and shutteth, and no man openeth;
verses.modern: "To the angel of the church in Philadelphia write: These things are said by the One who is holy and true, who has the key of David — who opens and no one shuts, who shuts and no one opens."

verses.kjv: I know thy works: behold, I have set before thee an open door, and no man can shut it: for thou hast a little strength, and hast kept my word, and hast not denied my name.
verses.modern: "I know Your works. I have placed before You an open door that no one can shut. You have only a little strength, yet You have kept My word and have not denied My name."

verses.kjv: Behold, I will make them of the synagogue of Satan, which say they are Jews, and are not, but do lie; behold, I will make them to come and worship before thy feet, and to know that I have loved thee.
verses.modern: "I will make those of the synagogue of Satan — who say they are Jews but are not, but lie — I will make them come and bow down at your feet and know that I have loved you."

verses.kjv: Because thou hast kept the word of my patience, I also will keep thee from the hour of temptation, which shall come upon all the world, to try them that dwell upon the earth.
verses.modern: "Because you have kept My word about patient endurance, I will keep you from the hour of trial that is coming on the whole world, to test those who live on the earth."

verses.kjv: Behold, I come quickly: hold that fast which thou hast, that no man take thy crown.
verses.modern: "I am coming soon. Hold fast to what you have, so that no one takes your crown."

verses.kjv: Him that overcometh will I make a pillar in the temple of my God, and he shall go no more out: and I will write upon him the name of my God, and the name of the city of my God, which is new Jerusalem, which cometh down out of heaven from my God: and I will write upon him my new name.
verses.modern: "The one who overcomes I will make a pillar in the temple of My God. He will never leave it. I will write on Him the name of My God and the name of the city of My God — the new Jerusalem, which comes down from heaven from My God — and I will also write on Him My new name."

verses.kjv: He that hath an ear, let him hear what the Spirit saith unto the churches.
verses.modern: "Let the one who has an ear listen to what the Spirit says to the churches."

verses.kjv: And unto the angel of the church of the Laodiceans write; These things saith the Amen, the faithful and true witness, the beginning of the creation of God;
verses.modern: "To the angel of the church in Laodicea write: These things are said by the Amen, the faithful and true Witness, the beginning of God's creation."

verses.kjv: I know thy works, that thou art neither cold nor hot: I would thou wert cold or hot.
verses.modern: "I know Your works — you are neither cold nor hot. I wish You were cold or hot."

verses.kjv: So then because thou art lukewarm, and neither cold nor hot, I will spue thee out of my mouth.
verses.modern: "Because You are lukewarm — neither hot nor cold — I am about to spit You out of My mouth."

verses.kjv: Because thou sayest, I am rich, and increased with goods, and have need of nothing; and knowest not that thou art wretched, and miserable, and poor, and blind, and naked:
verses.modern: "You say, 'I am rich; I have grown wealthy and need nothing.' But You do not know that You are wretched, miserable, poor, blind, and naked."

verses.kjv: I counsel thee to buy of me gold tried in the fire, that thou mayest be rich; and white raiment, that thou mayest be clothed, and that the shame of thy nakedness do not appear; and anoint thine eyes with eyesalve, that thou mayest see.
verses.modern: "I counsel You to buy from Me gold refined in fire so You can be truly rich, and white clothes to wear so Your shameful nakedness is covered, and eye salve to put on Your eyes so You can see."

verses.kjv: As many as I love, I rebuke and chasten: be zealous therefore, and repent.
verses.modern: "Those I love I rebuke and discipline. Be earnest, therefore, and repent."

verses.kjv: Behold, I stand at the door, and knock: if any man hear my voice, and open the door, I will come in to him, and will sup with him, and he with me.
verses.modern: "I stand at the door and knock. If anyone hears My voice and opens the door, I will come in and eat with Him, and He with Me."

verses.kjv: To him that overcometh will I grant to sit with me in my throne, even as I also overcame, and am set down with my Father in his throne.
verses.modern: "To the one who overcomes I will give the right to sit with Me on My throne, just as I overcame and sat down with My Father on His throne."

verses.kjv: He that hath an ear, let him hear what the Spirit saith unto the churches.
verses.modern: "Let the one who has an ear listen to what the Spirit says to the churches."

chapters.summary: Christ dictates letters to three churches: Sardis, which has a name that it lives but is dead; Philadelphia, which has kept His word and will be kept from the hour of temptation that will come upon all the world; and Laodicea, which is lukewarm — neither cold nor hot — and will be spewed out of His mouth unless it repents.

verses.kjv: After this I looked, and, behold, a door was opened in heaven: and the first voice which I heard was as it were of a trumpet talking with me; which said, Come up hither, and I will shew thee things which must be hereafter.
verses.modern: After this I looked, and there before me was an open door in heaven. The first voice I had heard — like a trumpet — spoke to me again: "Come up here, and I will show you what must take place after this."

verses.kjv: And immediately I was in the Spirit: and, behold, a throne was set in heaven, and one sat on the throne.
verses.modern: At once I was in the Spirit. There before me was a throne in heaven, and Someone was seated on the throne.

verses.kjv: And he that sat was to look upon like a jasper and a sardine stone: and there was a rainbow round about the throne, in sight like unto an emerald.
verses.modern: The One seated there looked like jasper and carnelian. Around the throne was a rainbow that looked like an emerald.

verses.kjv: And round about the throne were four and twenty seats: and upon the seats I saw four and twenty elders sitting, clothed in white raiment; and they had on their heads crowns of gold.
verses.modern: Surrounding the throne were twenty-four other thrones, and seated on them were twenty-four elders. They were dressed in white and had golden crowns on their heads.

verses.kjv: And out of the throne proceeded lightnings and thunderings and voices: and there were seven lamps of fire burning before the throne, which are the seven Spirits of God.
verses.modern: From the throne came flashes of lightning, rumblings, and thunder. Before the throne seven lamps were blazing — these are the seven Spirits of God.

verses.kjv: And before the throne there was a sea of glass like unto crystal: and in the midst of the throne, and round about the throne, were four beasts full of eyes before and behind.
verses.modern: Before the throne there was what looked like a sea of glass, clear as crystal. In the center around the throne were four living creatures, covered with eyes in front and behind.

verses.kjv: And the first beast was like a lion, and the second beast like a calf, and the third beast had a face as a man, and the fourth beast was like a flying eagle.
verses.modern: The first living creature was like a lion. The second was like a calf. The third had a face like a man. The fourth was like a flying eagle.

verses.kjv: And the four beasts had each of them six wings about him; and they were full of eyes within: and they rest not day and night, saying, Holy, holy, holy, Lord God Almighty, which was, and is, and is to come.
verses.modern: Each of the four living creatures had six wings and was covered with eyes all around and inside. Day and night they never stop saying: "Holy, holy, holy is the Lord God Almighty, who was, and is, and is to come."

verses.kjv: And when those beasts give glory and honour and thanks to him that sat on the throne, who liveth for ever and ever,
verses.modern: Whenever the living creatures give glory, honor, and thanks to Him who sits on the throne and lives for ever and ever,

verses.kjv: The four and twenty elders fall down before him that sat on the throne, and worship him that liveth for ever and ever, and cast their crowns before the throne, saying,
verses.modern: The twenty-four elders fall down before Him who sits on the throne and worship Him who lives for ever and ever. They lay their crowns before the throne and say:

verses.kjv: Thou art worthy, O Lord, to receive glory and honour and power: for thou hast created all things, and for thy pleasure they are and were created.
verses.modern: "You are worthy, O Lord, to receive glory and honor and power, for You created all things. By Your will they were created and exist."

chapters.summary: John sees a door opened in heaven and a throne set in heaven with One sitting on it, surrounded by twenty-four elders and four living creatures. The living creatures cry "Holy, holy, holy, Lord God Almighty, which was, and is, and is to come," and the elders cast their crowns before the throne, worshiping Him who lives for ever and ever.

verses.kjv: And I saw in the right hand of him that sat on the throne a book written within and on the backside, sealed with seven seals.
verses.modern: I saw in the right hand of Him who sat on the throne a scroll written on the inside and on the back, sealed with seven seals.

verses.kjv: And I saw a strong angel proclaiming with a loud voice, Who is worthy to open the book, and to loose the seals thereof?
verses.modern: A mighty angel proclaimed with a loud voice, "Who is worthy to open the scroll and break its seals?"

verses.kjv: And no man in heaven, nor in earth, neither under the earth, was able to open the book, neither to look thereon.
verses.modern: No one in heaven or on earth or under the earth was able to open the scroll or look into it.

verses.kjv: And I wept much, because no man was found worthy to open and to read the book, neither to look thereon.
verses.modern: I wept greatly because no one was found worthy to open the scroll or look into it.

verses.kjv: And one of the elders saith unto me, Weep not: behold, the Lion of the tribe of Juda, the Root of David, hath prevailed to open the book, and to loose the seven seals thereof.
verses.modern: Then one of the elders said to me, "Do not weep. The Lion of the tribe of Judah, the Root of David, has prevailed to open the scroll and its seven seals."

verses.kjv: And I beheld, and, lo, in the midst of the throne and of the four beasts, and in the midst of the elders, stood a Lamb as it had been slain, having seven horns and seven eyes, which are the seven Spirits of God sent forth into all the earth.
verses.modern: Then I saw, in the midst of the throne and the four living creatures and among the elders, a Lamb standing — it looked as though it had been slain. It had seven horns and seven eyes, which are the seven Spirits of God sent out into all the earth.

verses.kjv: And he came and took the book out of the right hand of him that sat upon the throne.
verses.modern: He came and took the scroll from the right hand of Him who sat on the throne.

verses.kjv: And when he had taken the book, the four beasts and four and twenty elders fell down before the Lamb, having every one of them harps, and golden vials full of odours, which are the prayers of saints.
verses.modern: When He took the scroll, the four living creatures and the twenty-four elders fell down before the Lamb. Each one had a harp and golden bowls full of incense, which are the prayers of the saints.

verses.kjv: And they sung a new song, saying, Thou art worthy to take the book, and to open the seals thereof: for thou wast slain, and hast redeemed us to God by thy blood out of every kindred, and tongue, and people, and nation;
verses.modern: And they sang a new song, saying, "You are worthy to take the book and to open the seals thereof; for You were slain, and have redeemed us to God by Your blood out of every kindred, and tongue, and people, and nation,

verses.kjv: And hast made us unto our God kings and priests: and we shall reign on the earth.
verses.modern: and have made us to our God kings and priests, and we shall reign on the earth."

verses.kjv: And I beheld, and I heard the voice of many angels round about the throne and the beasts and the elders: and the number of them was ten thousand times ten thousand, and thousands of thousands;
verses.modern: I looked, and I heard the voices of many angels surrounding the throne, the living creatures, and the elders. Their number was ten thousand times ten thousand — thousands upon thousands.

verses.kjv: Saying with a loud voice, Worthy is the Lamb that was slain to receive power, and riches, and wisdom, and strength, and honour, and glory, and blessing.
verses.modern: They cried out with a loud voice: "Worthy is the Lamb Who was slain to receive power and riches and wisdom and strength and honor and glory and blessing!"

verses.kjv: And every creature which is in heaven, and on the earth, and under the earth, and such as are in the sea, and all that are in them, heard I saying, Blessing, and honour, and glory, and power, be unto him that sitteth upon the throne, and unto the Lamb for ever and ever.
verses.modern: Then I heard every creature in heaven and on earth and under the earth and in the sea — all that is in them — saying: "Blessing and honor and glory and power be to Him who sits on the throne and to the Lamb for ever and ever!"

verses.kjv: And the four beasts said, Amen. And the four and twenty elders fell down and worshipped him that liveth for ever and ever.
verses.modern: The four living creatures said, "Amen." The twenty-four elders fell down and worshipped Him who lives for ever and ever.

chapters.summary: John sees a book sealed with seven seals in the right hand of Him who sits on the throne, and no man in heaven or earth is found worthy to open it. The Lamb who was slain — the Lion of the tribe of Judah — takes the book, and all heaven erupts in worship: "Thou art worthy...for Thou wast slain, and hast redeemed us to God by Thy blood."

verses.kjv: And I saw when the Lamb opened one of the seals, and I heard, as it were the noise of thunder, one of the four beasts saying, Come and see.
verses.modern: I watched as the Lamb opened the first of the seven seals. I heard one of the four living creatures say with a voice like thunder, "Come."

verses.kjv: And I saw, and behold a white horse: and he that sat on him had a bow; and a crown was given unto him: and he went forth conquering, and to conquer.
verses.modern: I looked, and there before me was a white horse. Its rider held a bow. A crown was given to him, and he rode out as a conqueror bent on conquest.

verses.kjv: And when he had opened the second seal, I heard the second beast say, Come and see.
verses.modern: When the Lamb opened the second seal, I heard the second living creature say, "Come."

verses.kjv: And there went out another horse that was red: and power was given to him that sat thereon to take peace from the earth, and that they should kill one another: and there was given unto him a great sword.
verses.modern: Another horse came out — a fiery red one. Its rider was given power to take peace from the earth and to make men kill one another. A great sword was given to him.

verses.kjv: And when he had opened the third seal, I heard the third beast say, Come and see. And I beheld, and lo a black horse; and he that sat on him had a pair of balances in his hand.
verses.modern: When the Lamb opened the third seal, I heard the third living creature say, "Come." I looked, and there before me was a black horse. Its rider was holding a pair of scales in His hand.

verses.kjv: And I heard a voice in the midst of the four beasts say, A measure of wheat for a penny, and three measures of barley for a penny; and see thou hurt not the oil and the wine.
verses.modern: Then I heard what sounded like a voice among the four living creatures, saying, "A quart of wheat for a day's wages, and three quarts of barley for a day's wages. Do not damage the oil and the wine."

verses.kjv: And when he had opened the fourth seal, I heard the voice of the fourth beast say, Come and see.
verses.modern: When the Lamb opened the fourth seal, I heard the voice of the fourth living creature say, "Come."

verses.kjv: And I looked, and behold a pale horse: and his name that sat on him was Death, and Hell followed with him. And power was given unto them over the fourth part of the earth, to kill with sword, and with hunger, and with death, and with the beasts of the earth.
verses.modern: I looked, and there before me was a pale horse. Its rider's name was Death, and Hell followed close behind him. They were given power over a fourth of the earth — to kill by sword, famine, plague, and by the wild beasts of the earth.

verses.kjv: And when he had opened the fifth seal, I saw under the altar the souls of them that were slain for the word of God, and for the testimony which they held:
verses.modern: When he opened the fifth seal, I saw under the altar the souls of those who had been slain for the word of God and for the testimony they had maintained.

verses.kjv: And they cried with a loud voice, saying, How long, O Lord, holy and true, dost thou not judge and avenge our blood on them that dwell on the earth?
verses.modern: They cried out with a loud voice, "How long, O Lord — holy and true — will You wait before You judge and avenge our blood on those who live on the earth?"

verses.kjv: And white robes were given unto every one of them; and it was said unto them, that they should rest yet for a little season, until their fellowservants also and their brethren, that should be killed as they were, should be fulfilled.
verses.modern: Each of them was given a white robe. They were told to wait a little longer, until the full number of their fellow servants and brothers who were to be killed as they had been killed was completed.

verses.kjv: And I beheld when he had opened the sixth seal, and, lo, there was a great earthquake; and the sun became black as sackcloth of hair, and the moon became as blood;
verses.modern: I watched as he opened the sixth seal. There was a great earthquake. The sun turned black like sackcloth made of goat hair. The whole moon turned blood red.

verses.kjv: And the stars of heaven fell unto the earth, even as a fig tree casteth her untimely figs, when she is shaken of a mighty wind.
verses.modern: The stars of the sky fell to earth, like figs dropping from a fig tree when shaken by a strong wind.

verses.kjv: And the heaven departed as a scroll when it is rolled together; and every mountain and island were moved out of their places.
verses.modern: The sky receded like a scroll rolling up, and every mountain and island was moved from its place.

verses.kjv: And the kings of the earth, and the great men, and the rich men, and the chief captains, and the mighty men, and every bondman, and every free man, hid themselves in the dens and in the rocks of the mountains;
verses.modern: The kings of the earth, the great men, the rich, the military commanders, the mighty, and every slave and free man hid themselves in the caves and among the rocks of the mountains.

verses.kjv: And said to the mountains and rocks, Fall on us, and hide us from the face of him that sitteth on the throne, and from the wrath of the Lamb:
verses.modern: They called to the mountains and rocks, "Fall on us and hide us from the face of Him who sits on the throne and from the wrath of the Lamb!"

verses.kjv: For the great day of his wrath is come; and who shall be able to stand?
verses.modern: "The great day of His wrath has come, and who is able to stand?"

chapters.summary: The Lamb opens six seals. The first four bring the four horsemen — conquest, war, famine, and death. The fifth seal reveals the souls of martyrs under the altar crying, "How long, O Lord?" The sixth seal brings a great earthquake, the sun turns black, the moon becomes as blood, and the kings of the earth hide themselves, crying to the mountains to fall on them.

verses.kjv: And after these things I saw four angels standing on the four corners of the earth, holding the four winds of the earth, that the wind should not blow on the earth, nor on the sea, nor on any tree.
verses.modern: After this I saw four angels standing at the four corners of the earth, holding back the four winds of the earth so no wind would blow on the land, the sea, or any tree.

verses.kjv: And I saw another angel ascending from the east, having the seal of the living God: and he cried with a loud voice to the four angels, to whom it was given to hurt the earth and the sea,
verses.modern: Then I saw another angel coming up from the east, holding the seal of the living God. He called out with a loud voice to the four angels who had been given power to harm the land and the sea:

verses.kjv: Saying, Hurt not the earth, neither the sea, nor the trees, till we have sealed the servants of our God in their foreheads.
verses.modern: "Do not harm the land or the sea or the trees until we have sealed the servants of our God on their foreheads."

verses.kjv: And I heard the number of them which were sealed: and there were sealed an hundred and forty and four thousand of all the tribes of the children of Israel.
verses.modern: Then I heard the number of those who were sealed: 144,000 from all the tribes of the children of Israel.

verses.kjv: Of the tribe of Juda were sealed twelve thousand. Of the tribe of Reuben were sealed twelve thousand. Of the tribe of Gad were sealed twelve thousand.
verses.modern: From the tribe of Judah 12,000 were sealed. From the tribe of Reuben 12,000. From the tribe of Gad 12,000.

verses.kjv: Of the tribe of Aser were sealed twelve thousand. Of the tribe of Nepthalim were sealed twelve thousand. Of the tribe of Manasses were sealed twelve thousand.
verses.modern: From the tribe of Aser 12,000. From the tribe of Nepthalim 12,000. From the tribe of Manasses 12,000.

verses.kjv: Of the tribe of Simeon were sealed twelve thousand. Of the tribe of Levi were sealed twelve thousand. Of the tribe of Issachar were sealed twelve thousand.
verses.modern: From the tribe of Simeon 12,000. From the tribe of Levi 12,000. From the tribe of Issachar 12,000.

verses.kjv: Of the tribe of Zabulon were sealed twelve thousand. Of the tribe of Joseph were sealed twelve thousand. Of the tribe of Benjamin were sealed twelve thousand.
verses.modern: From the tribe of Zabulon 12,000. From the tribe of Joseph 12,000. From the tribe of Benjamin 12,000.

verses.kjv: After this I beheld, and, lo, a great multitude, which no man could number, of all nations, and kindreds, and people, and tongues, stood before the throne, and before the Lamb, clothed with white robes, and palms in their hands;
verses.modern: After this I looked, and there was a great crowd that no one could count — from every nation, every family, every people and language. They stood before the throne and before the Lamb, wearing white robes and holding palm branches in their hands.

verses.kjv: And cried with a loud voice, saying, Salvation to our God which sitteth upon the throne, and unto the Lamb.
verses.modern: They cried out with a loud voice, "Salvation belongs to our God Who sits on the throne, and to the Lamb!"

verses.kjv: And all the angels stood round about the throne, and about the elders and the four beasts, and fell before the throne on their faces, and worshipped God,
verses.modern: All the angels were standing around the throne and around the elders and the four living creatures. They fell on their faces before the throne and worshipped God,

verses.kjv: Saying, Amen: Blessing, and glory, and wisdom, and thanksgiving, and honour, and power, and might, be unto our God for ever and ever. Amen.
verses.modern: Saying, "Amen! Blessing and glory and wisdom and thanksgiving and honor and power and might be to our God for ever and ever. Amen."

verses.kjv: And one of the elders answered, saying unto me, What are these which are arrayed in white robes? and whence came they?
verses.modern: Then one of the elders asked me, "Who are these dressed in white robes, and from where did they come?"

verses.kjv: And I said unto him, Sir, thou knowest. And he said to me, These are they which came out of great tribulation, and have washed their robes, and made them white in the blood of the Lamb.
verses.modern: I answered, "Sir, you know." He said to me, "These are the ones who have come out of the great tribulation. They have washed their robes and made them white in the blood of the Lamb."

verses.kjv: Therefore are they before the throne of God, and serve him day and night in his temple: and he that sitteth on the throne shall dwell among them.
verses.modern: "Therefore they are before the throne of God and serve Him day and night in His temple. He who sits on the throne will shelter them."

verses.kjv: They shall hunger no more, neither thirst any more; neither shall the sun light on them, nor any heat.
verses.modern: "They will never be hungry or thirsty again. The sun will not beat on them, nor any scorching heat."

verses.kjv: For the Lamb which is in the midst of the throne shall feed them, and shall lead them unto living fountains of waters: and God shall wipe away all tears from their eyes.
verses.modern: "The Lamb in the center before the throne will be their Shepherd. He will lead them to springs of living water. And God will wipe away every tear from their eyes."

chapters.summary: John sees four angels holding back the winds of the earth until one hundred forty-four thousand from the twelve tribes of Israel are sealed on their foreheads. He then sees a great multitude that no man can number, out of every nation and tongue, standing before the throne in white robes, who have come out of great tribulation and washed their robes in the blood of the Lamb.

verses.kjv: And when he had opened the seventh seal, there was silence in heaven about the space of half an hour.
verses.modern: When the Lamb opened the seventh seal, there was silence in heaven for about half an hour.

verses.kjv: And I saw the seven angels which stood before God; and to them were given seven trumpets.
verses.modern: I saw the seven angels who stand before God, and seven trumpets were given to them.

verses.kjv: And another angel came and stood at the altar, having a golden censer; and there was given unto him much incense, that he should offer it with the prayers of all saints upon the golden altar which was before the throne.
verses.modern: Another angel came and stood at the altar, holding a golden censer. He was given a great quantity of incense to offer with the prayers of all the saints on the golden altar before the throne.

verses.kjv: And the smoke of the incense, which came with the prayers of the saints, ascended up before God out of the angel's hand.
verses.modern: The smoke of the incense, together with the prayers of the saints, rose up before God from the angel's hand.

verses.kjv: And the angel took the censer, and filled it with fire of the altar, and cast it into the earth: and there were voices, and thunderings, and lightnings, and an earthquake.
verses.modern: Then the angel took the censer, filled it with fire from the altar, and hurled it to the earth. There came thunder, rumblings, flashes of lightning, and an earthquake.

verses.kjv: And the seven angels which had the seven trumpets prepared themselves to sound.
verses.modern: Then the seven angels who had the seven trumpets prepared to sound them.

verses.kjv: The first angel sounded, and there followed hail and fire mingled with blood, and they were cast upon the earth: and the third part of trees was burnt up, and all green grass was burnt up.
verses.modern: The first angel sounded his trumpet. Hail and fire mixed with blood were hurled down on the earth. A third of the earth was burned up, a third of the trees were burned up, and all green grass was burned up.

verses.kjv: And the second angel sounded, and as it were a great mountain burning with fire was cast into the sea: and the third part of the sea became blood;
verses.modern: The second angel sounded his trumpet. Something like a huge mountain blazing with fire was thrown into the sea. A third of the sea turned to blood.

verses.kjv: And the third part of the creatures which were in the sea, and had life, died; and the third part of the ships were destroyed.
verses.modern: A third of the living creatures in the sea died, and a third of the ships were destroyed.

verses.kjv: And the third angel sounded, and there fell a great star from heaven, burning as it were a lamp, and it fell upon the third part of the rivers, and upon the fountains of waters;
verses.modern: The third angel sounded his trumpet. A great star blazing like a torch fell from the sky on a third of the rivers and on the springs of water.

verses.kjv: And the name of the star is called Wormwood: and the third part of the waters became wormwood; and many men died of the waters, because they were made bitter.
verses.modern: The name of the star is Wormwood. A third of the waters turned bitter like wormwood, and many people died from the waters, because they had turned bitter.

verses.kjv: And the fourth angel sounded, and the third part of the sun was smitten, and the third part of the moon, and the third part of the stars; so as the third part of them was darkened, and the day shone not for a third part of it, and the night likewise.
verses.modern: The fourth angel sounded his trumpet. A third of the sun was struck, a third of the moon, and a third of the stars — so that a third of them turned dark. A third of the day had no light, and a third of the night as well.

verses.kjv: And I beheld, and heard an angel flying through the midst of heaven, saying with a loud voice, Woe, woe, woe, to the inhabiters of the earth by reason of the other voices of the trumpet of the three angels, which are yet to sound!
verses.modern: I looked, and I heard an eagle flying in midair call out with a loud voice: "Woe! Woe! Woe to the people who live on the earth, because of the trumpet blasts about to be sounded by the other three angels!"

chapters.summary: The Lamb opens the seventh seal, and there is silence in heaven for about half an hour. Seven angels are given seven trumpets. The first four trumpets bring hail and fire mixed with blood, a burning mountain cast into the sea, a great star called Wormwood that poisons the waters, and darkness on a third of the sun, moon, and stars.

verses.kjv: And the fifth angel sounded, and I saw a star fall from heaven unto the earth: and to him was given the key of the bottomless pit.
verses.modern: The fifth angel sounded his trumpet. I saw a star that had fallen from the sky to the earth. The star was given the key to the shaft of the bottomless pit.

verses.kjv: And he opened the bottomless pit; and there arose a smoke out of the pit, as the smoke of a great furnace; and the sun and the air were darkened by reason of the smoke of the pit.
verses.modern: When he opened the bottomless pit, smoke rose from it like smoke from a gigantic furnace. The sun and sky were darkened by the smoke from the pit.

verses.kjv: And there came out of the smoke locusts upon the earth: and unto them was given power, as the scorpions of the earth have power.
verses.modern: Out of the smoke came locusts down on the earth. They were given power like the power of scorpions of the earth.

verses.kjv: And it was commanded them that they should not hurt the grass of the earth, neither any green thing, neither any tree; but only those men which have not the seal of God in their foreheads.
verses.modern: They were told not to harm the grass of the earth or any plant or tree, but only those people who did not have the seal of God on their foreheads.

verses.kjv: And to them it was given that they should not kill them, but that they should be tormented five months: and their torment was as the torment of a scorpion, when he striketh a man.
verses.modern: They were not given power to kill them, but only to torment them for five months. Their torment was like the sting of a scorpion when it strikes a person.

verses.kjv: And in those days shall men seek death, and shall not find it; and shall desire to die, and death shall flee from them.
verses.modern: During those days people will seek death but will not find it. They will long to die, but death will flee from them.

verses.kjv: And the shapes of the locusts were like unto horses prepared unto battle; and on their heads were as it were crowns like gold, and their faces were as the faces of men.
verses.modern: The locusts looked like horses prepared for battle. On their heads they wore what looked like golden crowns. Their faces were like human faces.

verses.kjv: And they had hair as the hair of women, and their teeth were as the teeth of lions.
verses.modern: Their hair was like women's hair, and their teeth were like lions' teeth.

verses.kjv: And they had breastplates, as it were breastplates of iron; and the sound of their wings was as the sound of chariots of many horses running to battle.
verses.modern: They had chests like breastplates of iron, and the sound of their wings was like the thundering of many horses and chariots rushing into battle.

verses.kjv: And they had tails like unto scorpions, and there were stings in their tails: and their power was to hurt men five months.
verses.modern: They had tails with stingers like scorpions, and in their tails they had power to torment people for five months.

verses.kjv: And they had a king over them, which is the angel of the bottomless pit, whose name in the Hebrew tongue is Abaddon, but in the Greek tongue hath his name Apollyon.
verses.modern: They had as king over them the angel of the bottomless pit. His name in Hebrew is Abaddon, and in Greek his name is Apollyon.

verses.kjv: One woe is past; and, behold, there come two woes more hereafter.
verses.modern: The first woe is past. Two other woes are still to come.

verses.kjv: And the sixth angel sounded, and I heard a voice from the four horns of the golden altar which is before God,
verses.modern: The sixth angel sounded his trumpet. I heard a voice coming from the four horns of the golden altar before God.

verses.kjv: Saying to the sixth angel which had the trumpet, Loose the four angels which are bound in the great river Euphrates.
verses.modern: It said to the sixth angel who had the trumpet, "Release the four angels who are bound at the great river Euphrates."

verses.kjv: And the four angels were loosed, which were prepared for an hour, and a day, and a month, and a year, for to slay the third part of men.
verses.modern: The four angels who had been kept ready for this very hour, day, month, and year were released to kill a third of mankind.

verses.kjv: And the number of the army of the horsemen were two hundred thousand thousand: and I heard the number of them.
verses.modern: The number of the mounted troops was two hundred million. I heard their number.

verses.kjv: And thus I saw the horses in the vision, and them that sat on them, having breastplates of fire, and of jacinth, and brimstone: and the heads of the horses were as the heads of lions; and out of their mouths issued fire and smoke and brimstone.
verses.modern: In my vision the horses and their riders wore breastplates of fiery red, dark blue, and yellow like sulfur. The heads of the horses were like the heads of lions. Out of their mouths came fire, smoke, and sulfur.

verses.kjv: By these three was the third part of men killed, by the fire, and by the smoke, and by the brimstone, which issued out of their mouths.
verses.modern: A third of mankind was killed by the three plagues — the fire, the smoke, and the sulfur that came out of their mouths.

verses.kjv: For their power is in their mouth, and in their tails: for their tails were like unto serpents, and had heads, and with them they do hurt.
verses.modern: The horses' power to harm was in their mouths and in their tails. Their tails were like snakes, with heads that could inflict injury.

verses.kjv: And the rest of the men which were not killed by these plagues yet repented not of the works of their hands, that they should not worship devils, and idols of gold, and silver, and brass, and stone, and of wood: which neither can see, nor hear, nor walk:
verses.modern: The rest of mankind — those not killed by these plagues — still did not repent of the works of their hands. They did not stop worshipping demons and idols of gold, silver, bronze, stone, and wood — which cannot see, hear, or walk.

verses.kjv: Neither repented they of their murders, nor of their sorceries, nor of their fornication, nor of their thefts.
verses.modern: They did not repent of their murders, their sorceries, their fornication, or their thefts.

chapters.summary: The fifth trumpet opens the bottomless pit, and locusts with the power of scorpions torment men for five months — their king is the angel of the bottomless pit called Abaddon. The sixth trumpet releases four angels bound at the great river Euphrates, and an army of two hundred thousand thousand horsemen kills a third part of men, yet the rest do not repent of their idolatry or murders.

verses.kjv: And I saw another mighty angel come down from heaven, clothed with a cloud: and a rainbow was upon his head, and his face was as it were the sun, and his feet as pillars of fire:
verses.modern: Then I saw another mighty angel coming down from heaven, wrapped in a cloud. A rainbow was on his head. His face was like the sun, and his legs were like pillars of fire.

verses.kjv: And he had in his hand a little book open: and he set his right foot upon the sea, and his left foot on the earth,
verses.modern: He was holding in his hand a little scroll, open. He placed his right foot on the sea and his left foot on the land.

verses.kjv: And cried with a loud voice, as when a lion roareth: and when he had cried, seven thunders uttered their voices.
verses.modern: He called out with a loud voice, like a lion roaring. When he called out, the seven thunders sounded with their voices.

verses.kjv: And when the seven thunders had uttered their voices, I was about to write: and I heard a voice from heaven saying unto me, Seal up those things which the seven thunders uttered, and write them not.
verses.modern: When the seven thunders spoke, I was about to write. But I heard a voice from heaven say, "Seal up what the seven thunders said, and do not write it down."

verses.kjv: And the angel which I saw stand upon the sea and upon the earth lifted up his hand to heaven,
verses.modern: Then the angel I had seen standing on the sea and on the land raised his right hand to heaven.

verses.kjv: And sware by him that liveth for ever and ever, who created heaven, and the things that therein are, and the earth, and the things that therein are, and the sea, and the things which are therein, that there should be time no longer:
verses.modern: He swore by Him who lives for ever and ever — who created heaven and all that is in it, the earth and all that is in it, and the sea and all that is in it — and said, "There will be no more delay."

verses.kjv: But in the days of the voice of the seventh angel, when he shall begin to sound, the mystery of God should be finished, as he hath declared to his servants the prophets.
verses.modern: "In the days when the seventh angel is about to sound his trumpet, the mystery of God will be accomplished, just as He announced to His servants the prophets."

verses.kjv: And the voice which I heard from heaven spake unto me again, and said, Go and take the little book which is open in the hand of the angel which standeth upon the sea and upon the earth.
verses.modern: Then the voice I had heard from heaven spoke to me again: "Go, take the little scroll that is open in the hand of the angel who is standing on the sea and on the land."

verses.kjv: And I went unto the angel, and said unto him, Give me the little book. And he said unto me, Take it, and eat it up; and it shall make thy belly bitter, but it shall be in thy mouth sweet as honey.
verses.modern: So I went to the angel and asked him to give me the little scroll. He said to me, "Take it and eat it. It will make your stomach sour, but in your mouth it will be sweet as honey."

verses.kjv: And I took the little book out of the angel's hand, and ate it up; and it was in my mouth sweet as honey: and as soon as I had eaten it, my belly was bitter.
verses.modern: I took the little scroll from the angel's hand and ate it. It was sweet as honey in my mouth, but when I had eaten it, my stomach turned sour.

verses.kjv: And he said unto me, Thou must prophesy again before many peoples, and nations, and tongues, and kings.
verses.modern: Then I was told, "You must prophesy again about many peoples, nations, languages, and kings."

chapters.summary: John sees a mighty angel come down from heaven with a little book open in his hand, setting his right foot on the sea and his left on the earth. The angel swears by Him who lives for ever that there shall be time no longer, and when the seventh angel sounds, the mystery of God shall be finished. John eats the little book, which is sweet in his mouth but bitter in his belly.

verses.kjv: And there was given me a reed like unto a rod: and the angel stood, saying, Rise, and measure the temple of God, and the altar, and them that worship therein.
verses.modern: I was given a reed like a measuring rod. The angel stood and said, "Rise and measure the temple of God and the altar, and count those who worship there."

verses.kjv: But the court which is without the temple leave out, and measure it not; for it is given unto the Gentiles: and the holy city shall they tread under foot forty and two months.
verses.modern: "But do not measure the outer court — leave it out. It has been given to the Gentiles. They will trample the holy city for forty-two months."

verses.kjv: And I will give power unto my two witnesses, and they shall prophesy a thousand two hundred and threescore days, clothed in sackcloth.
verses.modern: "I will give power to My two witnesses, and they will prophesy for 1,260 days, clothed in sackcloth."

verses.kjv: These are the two olive trees, and the two candlesticks standing before the God of the earth.
verses.modern: These are the two olive trees and the two lampstands that stand before the Lord of the earth.

verses.kjv: And if any man will hurt them, fire proceedeth out of their mouth, and devoureth their enemies: and if any man will hurt them, he must in this manner be killed.
verses.modern: If anyone tries to harm them, fire comes from their mouths and devours their enemies. Anyone who wants to harm them must be killed in this way.

verses.kjv: These have power to shut heaven, that it rain not in the days of their prophecy: and have power over waters to turn them to blood, and to smite the earth with all plagues, as often as they will.
verses.modern: They have power to shut up the sky so that no rain will fall during the time they are prophesying. They have power to turn the waters to blood and to strike the earth with every kind of plague as often as they choose.

verses.kjv: And when they shall have finished their testimony, the beast that ascendeth out of the bottomless pit shall make war against them, and shall overcome them, and kill them.
verses.modern: When they have finished their testimony, the beast that comes up from the bottomless pit will make war against them and overcome them and kill them.

verses.kjv: And their dead bodies shall lie in the street of the great city, which spiritually is called Sodom and Egypt, where also our Lord was crucified.
verses.modern: Their bodies will lie in the street of the great city — which is spiritually called Sodom and Egypt — where also their Lord was crucified.

verses.kjv: And they of the people and kindreds and tongues and nations shall see their dead bodies three days and an half, and shall not suffer their dead bodies to be put in graves.
verses.modern: For three and a half days, people from every nation, family, language, and people will stare at their bodies and refuse to allow them to be buried.

verses.kjv: And they that dwell upon the earth shall rejoice over them, and make merry, and shall send gifts one to another; because these two prophets tormented them that dwelt on the earth.
verses.modern: The people of the earth will celebrate and be glad. They will send each other gifts, because these two prophets had tormented those who live on the earth.

verses.kjv: And after three days and an half the Spirit of life from God entered into them, and they stood upon their feet; and great fear fell upon them which saw them.
verses.modern: But after three and a half days, the breath of life from God entered them. They stood on their feet, and great terror struck those who saw them.

verses.kjv: And they heard a great voice from heaven saying unto them, Come up hither. And they ascended up to heaven in a cloud; and their enemies beheld them.
verses.modern: Then they heard a loud voice from heaven calling to them, "Come up here." They went up to heaven in a cloud, while their enemies watched.

verses.kjv: And the same hour was there a great earthquake, and the tenth part of the city fell, and in the earthquake were slain of men seven thousand: and the remnant were affrighted, and gave glory to the God of heaven.
verses.modern: At that same hour there was a great earthquake. A tenth of the city collapsed. Seven thousand people were killed in the earthquake, and the survivors were terrified and gave glory to the God of heaven.

verses.kjv: The second woe is past; and, behold, the third woe cometh quickly.
verses.modern: The second woe has passed. The third woe is coming soon.

verses.kjv: And the seventh angel sounded; and there were great voices in heaven, saying, The kingdoms of this world are become the kingdoms of our Lord, and of his Christ; and he shall reign for ever and ever.
verses.modern: The seventh angel sounded His trumpet. Great voices in heaven said, "The kingdoms of this world have become the kingdoms of our Lord and of His Christ, and He will reign for ever and ever."

verses.kjv: And the four and twenty elders, which sat before God on their seats, fell upon their faces, and worshipped God,
verses.modern: The twenty-four elders who were seated on their thrones before God fell on their faces and worshipped God,

verses.kjv: Saying, We give thee thanks, O Lord God Almighty, which art, and wast, and art to come; because thou hast taken to thee thy great power, and hast reigned.
verses.modern: Saying, "We give You thanks, O Lord God Almighty, who is and who was, because You have taken Your great power and have begun to reign."

verses.kjv: And the nations were angry, and thy wrath is come, and the time of the dead, that they should be judged, and that thou shouldest give reward unto thy servants the prophets, and to the saints, and them that fear thy name, small and great; and shouldest destroy them which destroy the earth.
verses.modern: "The nations were angry, and your wrath has come. The time has come to judge the dead and to reward Your servants the prophets and the saints — those who fear Your name, both small and great — and to destroy those who destroy the earth."

verses.kjv: And the temple of God was opened in heaven, and there was seen in his temple the ark of his testament: and there were lightnings, and voices, and thunderings, and an earthquake, and great hail.
verses.modern: Then the temple of God in heaven was opened, and within His temple was seen the ark of His covenant. There came flashes of lightning, rumblings, thunder, an earthquake, and a great hailstorm.

chapters.summary: John is told to measure the temple of God, and two witnesses prophesy for one thousand two hundred and sixty days. The beast from the bottomless pit kills the witnesses, but after three and a half days the Spirit of life from God enters them and they ascend to heaven. The seventh trumpet sounds, and great voices in heaven declare, "The kingdoms of this world are become the kingdoms of our Lord, and of His Christ."

verses.kjv: And there appeared a great wonder in heaven; a woman clothed with the sun, and the moon under her feet, and upon her head a crown of twelve stars:
verses.modern: A great sign appeared in heaven: a woman clothed with the sun, with the moon under her feet and a crown of twelve stars on her head.

verses.kjv: And she being with child cried, travailing in birth, and pained to be delivered.
verses.modern: She was pregnant and cried out in the pain of labor, about to give birth.

verses.kjv: And there appeared another wonder in heaven; and behold a great red dragon, having seven heads and ten horns, and seven crowns upon his heads.
verses.modern: Then another sign appeared in heaven: a great red dragon with seven heads and ten horns, and seven crowns on his heads.

verses.kjv: And his tail drew the third part of the stars of heaven, and did cast them to the earth: and the dragon stood before the woman which was ready to be delivered, for to devour her child as soon as it was born.
verses.modern: His tail swept a third of the stars from the sky and hurled them to the earth. The dragon stood in front of the woman who was about to give birth, so that he might devour her child the moment it was born.

verses.kjv: And she brought forth a man child, who was to rule all nations with a rod of iron: and her child was caught up unto God, and to his throne.
verses.modern: She gave birth to a son, a male child, who will rule all the nations with an iron scepter. Her child was caught up to God and to His throne.

verses.kjv: And the woman fled into the wilderness, where she hath a place prepared of God, that they should feed her there a thousand two hundred and threescore days.
verses.modern: The woman fled into the wilderness to a place prepared for her by God, where she would be cared for for 1,260 days.

verses.kjv: And there was war in heaven: Michael and his angels fought against the dragon; and the dragon fought and his angels,
verses.modern: Then war broke out in heaven. Michael and his angels fought against the dragon, and the dragon and his angels fought back.

verses.kjv: And prevailed not; neither was their place found any more in heaven.
verses.modern: But the dragon was not strong enough, and they lost their place in heaven.

verses.kjv: And the great dragon was cast out, that old serpent, called the Devil, and Satan, which deceiveth the whole world: he was cast out into the earth, and his angels were cast out with him.
verses.modern: The great dragon was hurled down — that ancient serpent called the Devil, or Satan, who leads the whole world astray. He was hurled to the earth, and his angels with him.

verses.kjv: And I heard a loud voice saying in heaven, Now is come salvation, and strength, and the kingdom of our God, and the power of his Christ: for the accuser of our brethren is cast down, which accused them before our God day and night.
verses.modern: Then I heard a loud voice in heaven say: "Now have come the salvation and the power and the kingdom of our God, and the authority of His Christ. For the accuser of our brothers has been hurled down — He who accused them before our God day and night.

verses.kjv: And they overcame him by the blood of the Lamb, and by the word of their testimony; and they loved not their lives unto the death.
verses.modern: They overcame Him by the blood of the Lamb and by the word of their testimony. They did not love their lives so much as to shrink from death.

verses.kjv: Therefore rejoice, ye heavens, and ye that dwell in them. Woe to the inhabiters of the earth and of the sea! for the devil is come down unto you, having great wrath, because he knoweth that he hath but a short time.
verses.modern: Therefore rejoice, you heavens and you who dwell in them! But woe to the earth and the sea, because the devil has gone down to you. He is filled with fury, because he knows that his time is short."

verses.kjv: And when the dragon saw that he was cast unto the earth, he persecuted the woman which brought forth the man child.
verses.modern: When the dragon saw that he had been hurled to the earth, he pursued the woman who had given birth to the male child.

verses.kjv: And to the woman were given two wings of a great eagle, that she might fly into the wilderness, into her place, where she is nourished for a time, and times, and half a time, from the face of the serpent.
verses.modern: The woman was given the two wings of a great eagle, so that she might fly to the place prepared for her in the wilderness, where she would be taken care of for a time, times and half a time, out of the serpent's reach.

verses.kjv: And the serpent cast out of his mouth water as a flood after the woman, that he might cause her to be carried away of the flood.
verses.modern: Then from his mouth the serpent spewed water like a river, to overtake the woman and sweep her away with the torrent.

verses.kjv: And the earth helped the woman, and the earth opened her mouth, and swallowed up the flood which the dragon cast out of his mouth.
verses.modern: But the earth helped the woman by opening its mouth and swallowing the river that the dragon had spewed out of his mouth.

verses.kjv: And the dragon was wroth with the woman, and went to make war with the remnant of her seed, which keep the commandments of God, and have the testimony of Jesus Christ.
verses.modern: Then the dragon was furious with the woman and went off to wage war against the rest of her offspring — those who keep God's commandments and hold to the testimony of Jesus Christ.

chapters.summary: John sees a woman clothed with the sun who brings forth a man child destined to rule all nations with a rod of iron, and the child is caught up to God and His throne. A great red dragon — that old serpent called the Devil and Satan — is cast out of heaven, and Michael and his angels war against him. The dragon persecutes the woman, who is given wings to fly into the wilderness for a time, times, and half a time.

verses.kjv: And I stood upon the sand of the sea, and saw a beast rise up out of the sea, having seven heads and ten horns, and upon his horns ten crowns, and upon his heads the name of blasphemy.
verses.modern: I stood on the sand of the seashore. Then I saw a beast rising out of the sea. It had ten horns and seven heads, with ten crowns on its horns, and on each head a name that blasphemed God.

verses.kjv: And the beast which I saw was like unto a leopard, and his feet were as the feet of a bear, and his mouth as the mouth of a lion: and the dragon gave him his power, and his seat, and great authority.
verses.modern: The beast I saw resembled a leopard, but had feet like those of a bear and a mouth like that of a lion. The dragon gave the beast his power and his throne and great authority.

verses.kjv: And I saw one of his heads as it were wounded to death; and his deadly wound was healed: and all the world wondered after the beast.
verses.modern: One of the heads of the beast seemed to have had a fatal wound, but the fatal wound had been healed. The whole world was filled with wonder and followed the beast.

verses.kjv: And they worshipped the dragon which gave power unto the beast: and they worshipped the beast, saying, Who is like unto the beast? who is able to make war with him?
verses.modern: People worshiped the dragon because he had given authority to the beast, and they also worshiped the beast and asked, "Who is like the beast? Who can wage war against it?"

verses.kjv: And there was given unto him a mouth speaking great things and blasphemies; and power was given unto him to continue forty and two months.
verses.modern: The beast was given a mouth to speak proud words and blasphemies, and to exercise its authority for forty-two months.

verses.kjv: And he opened his mouth in blasphemy against God, to blaspheme his name, and his tabernacle, and them that dwell in heaven.
verses.modern: It opened its mouth to blaspheme God and to slander His name and His dwelling place and those who live in heaven.

verses.kjv: And it was given unto him to make war with the saints, and to overcome them: and power was given him over all kindreds, and tongues, and nations.
verses.modern: It was given power to wage war against God's holy people and to conquer them. And it was given authority over every tribe, people, language and nation.

verses.kjv: And all that dwell upon the earth shall worship him, whose names are not written in the book of life of the Lamb slain from the foundation of the world.
verses.modern: All inhabitants of the earth will worship the beast — all whose names have not been written in the book of life belonging to the Lamb Who was slain from the foundation of the world.

verses.kjv: If any man have an ear, let him hear.
verses.modern: Whoever has ears, let them hear.

verses.kjv: He that leadeth into captivity shall go into captivity: he that killeth with the sword must be killed with the sword. Here is the patience and the faith of the saints.
verses.modern: "If anyone is to go into captivity, into captivity they will go. If anyone is to be killed with the sword, with the sword they will be killed." This calls for patient endurance and faithfulness on the part of God's people.

verses.kjv: And I beheld another beast coming up out of the earth; and he had two horns like a lamb, and he spake as a dragon.
verses.modern: Then I saw a second beast, coming out of the earth. It had two horns like a lamb, but it spoke like a dragon.

verses.kjv: And he exerciseth all the power of the first beast before him, and causeth the earth and them which dwell therein to worship the first beast, whose deadly wound was healed.
verses.modern: It exercised all the authority of the first beast on its behalf, and made the earth and its inhabitants worship the first beast, whose fatal wound had been healed.

verses.kjv: And he doeth great wonders, so that he maketh fire come down from heaven on the earth in the sight of men,
verses.modern: And it performed great signs, even causing fire to come down from heaven to the earth in full view of the people.

verses.kjv: And deceiveth them that dwell on the earth by the means of those miracles which he had power to do in the sight of the beast; saying to them that dwell on the earth, that they should make an image to the beast, which had the wound by a sword, and did live.
verses.modern: Because of the signs it was given power to perform on behalf of the first beast, it deceived the inhabitants of the earth. It ordered them to set up an image in honor of the beast who was wounded by the sword and yet lived.

verses.kjv: And he had power to give life unto the image of the beast, that the image of the beast should both speak, and cause that as many as would not worship the image of the beast should be killed.
verses.modern: The second beast was given power to give breath to the image of the first beast, so that the image could speak and cause all who refused to worship the image to be killed.

verses.kjv: And he causeth all, both small and great, rich and poor, free and bond, to receive a mark in their right hand, or in their foreheads:
verses.modern: It also forced all people, great and small, rich and poor, free and slave, to receive a mark on their right hands or on their foreheads,

verses.kjv: And that no man might buy or sell, save he that had the mark, or the name of the beast, or the number of his name.
verses.modern: so that they could not buy or sell unless they had the mark, which is the name of the beast or the number of its name.

verses.kjv: Here is wisdom. Let him that hath understanding count the number of the beast: for it is the number of a man; and his number is Six hundred threescore and six.
verses.modern: This calls for wisdom. Let the person who has insight calculate the number of the beast, for it is the number of a man. That number is 666.

chapters.summary: John sees a beast rise out of the sea with seven heads and ten horns, to whom the dragon gives his power and great authority, and all the world wonders after the beast. A second beast rises out of the earth, performing great signs and causing all to receive the mark of the beast — 666 — in their right hand or forehead, without which no man can buy or sell.

verses.kjv: And I looked, and, lo, a Lamb stood on the mount Sion, and with him an hundred forty and four thousand, having his Father's name written in their foreheads.
verses.modern: Then I looked, and there before me was the Lamb, standing on Mount Zion, and with Him 144,000 who had His Father's name written on their foreheads.

verses.kjv: And I heard a voice from heaven, as the voice of many waters, and as the voice of a great thunder: and I heard the voice of harpers harping with their harps:
verses.modern: And I heard a sound from heaven like the roar of rushing waters and like a loud peal of thunder. The sound I heard was like that of harpists playing their harps.
