verses.kjv: And they sung as it were a new song before the throne, and before the four beasts, and the elders: and no man could learn that song but the hundred and forty and four thousand, which were redeemed from the earth.
verses.modern: They sang a new song before the throne and before the four living creatures and the elders. No one could learn the song except the 144,000 who had been redeemed from the earth.

verses.kjv: These are they which were not defiled with women; for they are virgins. These are they which follow the Lamb whithersoever he goeth. These were redeemed from among men, being the firstfruits unto God and to the Lamb.
verses.modern: These are those who did not defile themselves with women, for they remained virgins. They follow the Lamb wherever He goes. They were purchased from among mankind and offered as firstfruits to God and the Lamb.

verses.kjv: And in their mouth was found no guile: for they are without fault before the throne of God.
verses.modern: And in their mouth was found no guile, for they are without fault before the throne of God.

verses.kjv: And I saw another angel fly in the midst of heaven, having the everlasting gospel to preach unto them that dwell on the earth, and to every nation, and kindred, and tongue, and people,
verses.modern: Then I saw another angel flying in midair, and he had the eternal gospel to proclaim to those who live on the earth — to every nation, tribe, language and people.

verses.kjv: Saying with a loud voice, Fear God, and give glory to him; for the hour of his judgment is come: and worship him that made heaven, and earth, and the sea, and the fountains of waters.
verses.modern: He said in a loud voice, "Fear God and give Him glory, because the hour of His judgment has come. Worship Him who made the heavens, the earth, the sea and the springs of water."

verses.kjv: And there followed another angel, saying, Babylon is fallen, is fallen, that great city, because she made all nations drink of the wine of the wrath of her fornication.
verses.modern: A second angel followed and said, "Fallen! Fallen is Babylon the Great, which made all the nations drink the maddening wine of her adulteries."

verses.kjv: And the third angel followed them, saying with a loud voice, If any man worship the beast and his image, and receive his mark in his forehead, or in his hand,
verses.modern: A third angel followed them and said in a loud voice: "If anyone worships the beast and its image and receives its mark on their forehead or hand,

verses.kjv: The same shall drink of the wine of the wrath of God, which is poured out without mixture into the cup of his indignation; and he shall be tormented with fire and brimstone in the presence of the holy angels, and in the presence of the Lamb:
verses.modern: they, too, will drink the wine of God's fury, which has been poured full strength into the cup of His wrath. They will be tormented with burning sulfur in the presence of the holy angels and of the Lamb.

verses.kjv: And the smoke of their torment ascendeth up for ever and ever: and they have no rest day nor night, who worship the beast and his image, and whosoever receiveth the mark of his name.
verses.modern: And the smoke of their torment will rise for ever and ever. There will be no rest day or night for those who worship the beast and its image, or for anyone who receives the mark of its name."

verses.kjv: Here is the patience of the saints: here are they that keep the commandments of God, and the faith of Jesus.
verses.modern: This calls for patient endurance on the part of the people of God Who keep His commandments and remain faithful to Jesus.

verses.kjv: And I heard a voice from heaven saying unto me, Write, Blessed are the dead which die in the Lord from henceforth: Yea, saith the Spirit, that they may rest from their labours; and their works do follow them.
verses.modern: Then I heard a voice from heaven say, "Write this: Blessed are the dead who die in the Lord from now on." "Yes," says the Spirit, "they will rest from their labor, for their deeds will follow them."

verses.kjv: And I looked, and behold a white cloud, and upon the cloud one sat like unto the Son of man, having on his head a golden crown, and in his hand a sharp sickle.
verses.modern: I looked, and there before me was a white cloud, and seated on the cloud was one like a son of man with a crown of gold on His head and a sharp sickle in His hand.

verses.kjv: And another angel came out of the temple, crying with a loud voice to him that sat on the cloud, Thrust in thy sickle, and reap: for the time is come for thee to reap; for the harvest of the earth is ripe.
verses.modern: Then another angel came out of the temple and called in a loud voice to Him who was sitting on the cloud, "Take Your sickle and reap, because the time to reap has come, for the harvest of the earth is ripe."

verses.kjv: And he that sat on the cloud thrust in his sickle on the earth; and the earth was reaped.
verses.modern: So He who was seated on the cloud swung his sickle over the earth, and the earth was harvested.

verses.kjv: And another angel came out of the temple which is in heaven, he also having a sharp sickle.
verses.modern: Another angel came out of the temple in heaven, and He too had a sharp sickle.

verses.kjv: And another angel came out from the altar, which had power over fire; and cried with a loud cry to him that had the sharp sickle, saying, Thrust in thy sharp sickle, and gather the clusters of the vine of the earth; for her grapes are fully ripe.
verses.modern: Still another angel, who had charge of the fire, came from the altar and called in a loud voice to Him who had the sharp sickle, "Take Your sharp sickle and gather the clusters of grapes from the earth's vine, because its grapes are ripe."

verses.kjv: And the angel thrust in his sickle into the earth, and gathered the vine of the earth, and cast it into the great winepress of the wrath of God.
verses.modern: The angel swung his sickle on the earth, gathered its grapes and threw them into the great winepress of God's wrath.

verses.kjv: And the winepress was trodden without the city, and blood came out of the winepress, even unto the horse bridles, by the space of a thousand and six hundred furlongs.
verses.modern: They were trampled in the winepress outside the city, and blood flowed out of the press, rising as high as the horses' bridles for a distance of 1,600 stadia.

chapters.summary: John sees the Lamb standing on mount Sion with the hundred forty-four thousand who have His Father's name written on their foreheads. Three angels fly through heaven: the first proclaims the everlasting gospel, the second declares that Babylon is fallen, and the third warns that whoever receives the mark of the beast will drink of the wine of the wrath of God. The Son of man thrusts in His sickle and the earth is reaped.

verses.kjv: And I saw another sign in heaven, great and marvellous, seven angels having the seven last plagues; for in them is filled up the wrath of God.
verses.modern: Then I saw another sign in heaven, great and marvellous: seven angels carrying the seven last plagues. With these, the wrath of God is complete.

verses.kjv: And I saw as it were a sea of glass mingled with fire: and them that had gotten the victory over the beast, and over his image, and over his mark, and over the number of his name, stand on the sea of glass, having the harps of God.
verses.modern: I saw what looked like a sea of glass mixed with fire. Standing on the sea of glass were those who had been victorious over the beast and its image and over the number of its name. They held the harps of God.

verses.kjv: And they sing the song of Moses the servant of God, and the song of the Lamb, saying, Great and marvellous are thy works, Lord God Almighty; just and true are thy ways, thou King of saints.
verses.modern: They sang the song of Moses the servant of God and the song of the Lamb, saying: "Great and marvellous are Your works, Lord God Almighty. Just and true are Your ways, O King of saints.

verses.kjv: Who shall not fear thee, O Lord, and glorify thy name? for thou only art holy: for all nations shall come and worship before thee; for thy judgments are made manifest.
verses.modern: Who shall not fear You, O Lord, and glorify Your name? For You alone are holy. All nations shall come and worship before You, for Your judgments have been made manifest."

verses.kjv: And after that I looked, and, behold, the temple of the tabernacle of the testimony in heaven was opened:
verses.modern: After this I looked, and the temple of the tabernacle of the testimony in heaven was opened.

verses.kjv: And the seven angels came out of the temple, having the seven plagues, clothed in pure and white linen, and having their breasts girded with golden girdles.
verses.modern: Out of the temple came the seven angels carrying the seven plagues. They were clothed in pure white linen and wore golden sashes around their chests.

verses.kjv: And one of the four beasts gave unto the seven angels seven golden vials full of the wrath of God, who liveth for ever and ever.
verses.modern: Then one of the four living creatures gave to the seven angels seven golden vials full of the wrath of God, Who lives for ever and ever.

verses.kjv: And the temple was filled with smoke from the glory of God, and from his power; and no man could enter into the temple, till the seven plagues of the seven angels were fulfilled.
verses.modern: The temple was filled with smoke from the glory of God and from His power. No one could enter the temple until the seven plagues of the seven angels were fulfilled.

chapters.summary: John sees seven angels having the seven last plagues, in which the wrath of God is filled up. Those who have gotten victory over the beast stand on a sea of glass mingled with fire, singing the song of Moses and the song of the Lamb. The temple of the tabernacle of the testimony in heaven is opened, and the seven angels are given seven golden vials full of the wrath of God.

verses.kjv: And I heard a great voice out of the temple saying to the seven angels, Go your ways, and pour out the vials of the wrath of God upon the earth.
verses.modern: I heard a loud voice from the temple saying to the seven angels, "Go and pour out the seven bowls of God's wrath on the earth."

verses.kjv: And the first went, and poured out his vial upon the earth; and there fell a noisome and grievous sore upon the men which had the mark of the beast, and upon them which worshipped his image.
verses.modern: The first angel went and poured out his bowl on the earth. Painful, ugly sores broke out on the people who had the mark of the beast and who worshiped his image.

verses.kjv: And the second angel poured out his vial upon the sea; and it became as the blood of a dead man: and every living soul died in the sea.
verses.modern: The second angel poured out his bowl on the sea. It turned to blood like that of a dead man, and every living creature in the sea died.

verses.kjv: And the third angel poured out his vial upon the rivers and fountains of waters; and they became blood.
verses.modern: The third angel poured out his bowl on the rivers and springs of water, and they turned to blood.

verses.kjv: And I heard the angel of the waters say, Thou art righteous, O Lord, which art, and wast, and shalt be, because thou hast judged thus.
verses.modern: I heard the angel of the waters say, "You are righteous, O Lord — You who are, and were, and are to come — because You have judged these things."

verses.kjv: For they have shed the blood of saints and prophets, and thou hast given them blood to drink; for they are worthy.
verses.modern: They shed the blood of saints and prophets, so You have given them blood to drink. They deserve it.

verses.kjv: And I heard another out of the altar say, Even so, Lord God Almighty, true and righteous are thy judgments.
verses.modern: I heard another voice from the altar say, "Yes, Lord God Almighty — Your judgments are true and righteous."

verses.kjv: And the fourth angel poured out his vial upon the sun; and power was given unto him to scorch men with fire.
verses.modern: The fourth angel poured out his bowl on the sun, and the sun was given power to scorch people with fire.

verses.kjv: And men were scorched with great heat, and blasphemed the name of God, which hath power over these plagues: and they repented not to give him glory.
verses.modern: People were seared by intense heat, and they cursed the name of God, Who had authority over these plagues. They refused to repent and give Him glory.

verses.kjv: And the fifth angel poured out his vial upon the seat of the beast; and his kingdom was full of darkness; and they gnawed their tongues for pain,
verses.modern: The fifth angel poured out his bowl on the throne of the beast, and his kingdom was plunged into darkness. People gnawed their tongues in agony

verses.kjv: And blasphemed the God of heaven because of their pains and their sores, and repented not of their deeds.
verses.modern: and cursed the God of heaven because of their pain and their sores. They refused to repent of what they had done.

verses.kjv: And the sixth angel poured out his vial upon the great river Euphrates; and the water thereof was dried up, that the way of the kings of the east might be prepared.
verses.modern: The sixth angel poured out his bowl on the great river Euphrates, and its water dried up to prepare the way for the kings of the east.

verses.kjv: And I saw three unclean spirits like frogs come out of the mouth of the dragon, and out of the mouth of the beast, and out of the mouth of the false prophet.
verses.modern: I saw three unclean spirits that looked like frogs come out of the mouth of the dragon, out of the mouth of the beast, and out of the mouth of the false prophet.

verses.kjv: For they are the spirits of devils, working miracles, which go forth unto the kings of the earth and of the whole world, to gather them to the battle of that great day of God Almighty.
verses.modern: These are demonic spirits that perform signs. They go out to the kings of the whole world to gather them for battle on the great day of God Almighty.

verses.kjv: Behold, I come as a thief. Blessed is he that watcheth, and keepeth his garments, lest he walk naked, and they see his shame.
verses.modern: "I am coming like a thief. Blessed is the one who stays alert and keeps his clothes ready, so he will not go naked and be exposed to shame."

verses.kjv: And he gathered them together into a place called in the Hebrew tongue Armageddon.
verses.modern: They were gathered to the place called Armageddon in the Hebrew language.

verses.kjv: And the seventh angel poured out his vial into the air; and there came a great voice out of the temple of heaven, from the throne, saying, It is done.
verses.modern: The seventh angel poured out his bowl into the air. A loud voice came from the throne in the temple of heaven, saying, "It is done!"

verses.kjv: And there were voices, and thunders, and lightnings; and there was a great earthquake, such as was not since men were upon the earth, so mighty an earthquake, and so great.
verses.modern: There came flashes of lightning, rumblings, and thunder. A great earthquake struck — the most severe since mankind has been on the earth.

verses.kjv: And the great city was divided into three parts, and the cities of the nations fell: and great Babylon came in remembrance before God, to give unto her the cup of the wine of the fierceness of his wrath.
verses.modern: The great city split into three parts, and the cities of the nations collapsed. God remembered great Babylon and gave her the cup filled with the wine of His fierce wrath.

verses.kjv: And every island fled away, and the mountains were not found.
verses.modern: Every island fled away, and the mountains were gone.

verses.kjv: And there fell upon men a great hail out of heaven, every stone about the weight of a talent: and men blasphemed God because of the plague of the hail; for the plague thereof was exceeding great.
verses.modern: Enormous hailstones, each weighing about a talent, fell on people from heaven. They cursed God because of the plague of hail, for it was a terrible plague.

chapters.summary: The seven vials of God's wrath are poured out. The first brings sores, the second and third turn the sea and rivers to blood, the fourth scorches men with fire, the fifth brings darkness on the beast's kingdom, the sixth dries up the Euphrates to prepare the way for the kings of the east, and the seventh brings the greatest earthquake in history and the fall of great Babylon.

verses.kjv: And there came one of the seven angels which had the seven vials, and talked with me, saying unto me, Come hither; I will shew unto thee the judgment of the great whore that sitteth upon many waters:
verses.modern: One of the seven angels who had the seven bowls came and spoke to me. "Come," he said, "I will show you the judgment of the great prostitute who sits on many waters."

verses.kjv: With whom the kings of the earth have committed fornication, and the inhabitants of the earth have been made drunk with the wine of her fornication.
verses.modern: The kings of the earth committed sexual immorality with her, and the people of the earth were made drunk with the wine of her immorality.

verses.kjv: So he carried me away in the spirit into the wilderness: and I saw a woman sit upon a scarlet coloured beast, full of names of blasphemy, having seven heads and ten horns.
verses.modern: He carried me away in the Spirit into a wilderness. I saw a woman sitting on a scarlet beast. The beast was covered with names of blasphemy and had seven heads and ten horns.

verses.kjv: And the woman was arrayed in purple and scarlet colour, and decked with gold and precious stones and pearls, having a golden cup in her hand full of abominations and filthiness of her fornication:
verses.modern: The woman was dressed in purple and scarlet and adorned with gold, precious stones, and pearls. She held a golden cup in her hand, filled with the abominations and filth of her immorality.

verses.kjv: And upon her forehead was a name written, MYSTERY, BABYLON THE GREAT, THE MOTHER OF HARLOTS AND ABOMINATIONS OF THE EARTH.
verses.modern: On her forehead was written a name — a mystery: BABYLON THE GREAT, THE MOTHER OF PROSTITUTES AND OF THE ABOMINATIONS OF THE EARTH.

verses.kjv: And I saw the woman drunken with the blood of the saints, and with the blood of the martyrs of Jesus: and when I saw her, I wondered with great admiration.
verses.modern: I saw the woman drunk with the blood of the saints and the blood of the martyrs of Jesus. When I saw her, I was greatly astonished.

verses.kjv: And the angel said unto me, Wherefore didst thou marvel? I will tell thee the mystery of the woman, and of the beast that carrieth her, which hath the seven heads and ten horns.
verses.modern: The angel said to me, "Why are you astonished? I will explain to you the mystery of the woman and of the beast she rides — the beast with seven heads and ten horns."

verses.kjv: The beast that thou sawest was, and is not; and shall ascend out of the bottomless pit, and go into perdition: and they that dwell on the earth shall wonder, whose names were not written in the book of life from the foundation of the world, when they behold the beast that was, and is not, and yet is.
verses.modern: The beast you saw once was, now is not, and will come up out of the bottomless pit before going to his destruction. The people of the earth — those whose names were not written in the book of life from the foundation of the world — will be astonished when they see the beast, because he was, is not, and yet will come.

verses.kjv: And here is the mind which hath wisdom. The seven heads are seven mountains, on which the woman sitteth.
verses.modern: This calls for a mind that has wisdom. The seven heads are seven mountains on which the woman sits.

verses.kjv: And there are seven kings: five are fallen, and one is, and the other is not yet come; and when he cometh, he must continue a short space.
verses.modern: They are also seven kings. Five have fallen, one is reigning now, and the other has not yet come. When he does come, he must remain only a short while.

verses.kjv: And the beast that was, and is not, even he is the eighth, and is of the seven, and goeth into perdition.
verses.modern: The beast who once was, and now is not, is himself an eighth king. He belongs to the seven, and he goes to his destruction.

verses.kjv: And the ten horns which thou sawest are ten kings, which have received no kingdom as yet; but receive power as kings one hour with the beast.
verses.modern: The ten horns you saw are ten kings who have not yet received a kingdom. They will receive authority as kings for one hour together with the beast.

verses.kjv: These have one mind, and shall give their power and strength unto the beast.
verses.modern: These kings all share one purpose, and they will give their power and authority to the beast.

verses.kjv: These shall make war with the Lamb, and the Lamb shall overcome them: for he is Lord of lords, and King of kings: and they that are with him are called, and chosen, and faithful.
verses.modern: They will wage war against the Lamb, but the Lamb will overcome them — for He is Lord of lords and King of kings. Those with Him are called, chosen, and faithful.

verses.kjv: And he saith unto me, The waters which thou sawest, where the whore sitteth, are peoples, and multitudes, and nations, and tongues.
verses.modern: Then the angel said to me, "The waters where the prostitute sits are peoples, crowds, nations, and languages."

verses.kjv: And the ten horns which thou sawest upon the beast, these shall hate the whore, and shall make her desolate and naked, and shall eat her flesh, and burn her with fire.
verses.modern: The ten horns and the beast will hate the prostitute. They will make her desolate and naked, eat her flesh, and burn her with fire.

verses.kjv: For God hath put in their hearts to fulfil his will, and to agree, and give their kingdom unto the beast, until the words of God shall be fulfilled.
verses.modern: God has put it in their hearts to carry out His purpose. They agreed to give their power to the beast until God's words are fulfilled.

verses.kjv: And the woman which thou sawest is that great city, which reigneth over the kings of the earth.
verses.modern: The woman you saw is the great city that rules over the kings of the earth.

chapters.summary: John sees the great whore sitting on a scarlet-colored beast with seven heads and ten horns, arrayed in purple and scarlet, holding a golden cup full of abominations, with the name MYSTERY, BABYLON THE GREAT, THE MOTHER OF HARLOTS written on her forehead. The angel explains that the seven heads are seven mountains and seven kings, and the ten horns will make war with the Lamb, but the Lamb shall overcome them.

verses.kjv: And after these things I saw another angel come down from heaven, having great power; and the earth was lightened with his glory.
verses.modern: After this I saw another angel coming down from heaven. He had great authority, and the earth was lit up by his glory.

verses.kjv: And he cried mightily with a strong voice, saying, Babylon the great is fallen, is fallen, and is become the habitation of devils, and the hold of every foul spirit, and a cage of every unclean and hateful bird.
verses.modern: He cried out in a mighty voice: "Fallen! Fallen is Babylon the great! She has become a home for demons and a haunt for every unclean spirit — a cage for every unclean and hateful bird."

verses.kjv: For all nations have drunk of the wine of the wrath of her fornication, and the kings of the earth have committed fornication with her, and the merchants of the earth are waxed rich through the abundance of her delicacies.
verses.modern: All the nations drank the wine of the wrath of her immorality. The kings of the earth committed immorality with her. The merchants of the earth grew rich from the power of her excessive pleasures.

verses.kjv: And I heard another voice from heaven, saying, Come out of her, my people, that ye be not partakers of her sins, and that ye receive not of her plagues.
verses.modern: I heard another voice from heaven say: "Come out of her, my people, so that you will not share in her sins or receive any of her plagues."

verses.kjv: For her sins have reached unto heaven, and God hath remembered her iniquities.
verses.modern: Her sins have piled up to heaven, and God has remembered her iniquities.

verses.kjv: Reward her even as she rewarded you, and double unto her double according to her works: in the cup which she hath filled fill to her double.
verses.modern: Pay her back as she has paid others. Give her double for what she has done. In the cup she mixed for others, pour her double the amount.

verses.kjv: How much she hath glorified herself, and lived deliciously, so much torment and sorrow give her: for she saith in her heart, I sit a queen, and am no widow, and shall see no sorrow.
verses.modern: Give her the same measure of torment and grief as the glory and luxury she gave herself. In her heart she says, "I sit as queen. I am not a widow, and I will never mourn."

verses.kjv: Therefore shall her plagues come in one day, death, and mourning, and famine; and she shall be utterly burned with fire: for strong is the Lord God who judgeth her.
verses.modern: Therefore her plagues will come in a single day — death, mourning, and famine. She will be burned up with fire, for mighty is the Lord God Who judges her.

verses.kjv: And the kings of the earth, who have committed fornication and lived deliciously with her, shall bewail her, and lament for her, when they shall see the smoke of her burning,
verses.modern: The kings of the earth who committed immorality and shared in her luxury will weep and mourn over her when they see the smoke of her burning.

verses.kjv: Standing afar off for the fear of her torment, saying, Alas, alas, that great city Babylon, that mighty city! for in one hour is thy judgment come.
verses.modern: They will stand far off in fear of her torment and cry out: "How terrible, how terrible — that great city, Babylon, that mighty city! In just one hour your judgment has come!"

verses.kjv: And the merchants of the earth shall weep and mourn over her; for no man buyeth their merchandise any more:
verses.modern: The merchants of the earth will weep and mourn over her, because no one buys their goods any longer —

verses.kjv: The merchandise of gold, and silver, and precious stones, and of pearls, and fine linen, and purple, and silk, and scarlet, and all thyine wood, and all manner vessels of ivory, and all manner vessels of most precious wood, and of brass, and iron, and marble,
verses.modern: goods of gold, silver, precious stones, and pearls; fine linen, purple, silk, and scarlet cloth; every kind of citron wood; articles of ivory, costly wood, bronze, iron, and marble;

verses.kjv: And cinnamon, and odours, and ointments, and frankincense, and wine, and oil, and fine flour, and wheat, and beasts, and sheep, and horses, and chariots, and slaves, and souls of men.
verses.modern: cinnamon, spice, incense, myrrh, and frankincense; wine, olive oil, fine flour, and wheat; cattle, sheep, horses, and carriages; and human lives — the souls of people.

verses.kjv: And the fruits that thy soul lusted after are departed from thee, and all things which were dainty and goodly are departed from thee, and thou shalt find them no more at all.
verses.modern: The fruit you craved is gone from you. All your luxury and splendor are lost to you — you will never find them again.

verses.kjv: The merchants of these things, which were made rich by her, shall stand afar off for the fear of her torment, weeping and wailing,
verses.modern: The merchants who sold these things and grew rich from her will stand far off, terrified at her torment, weeping and mourning.

verses.kjv: And saying, Alas, alas, that great city, that was clothed in fine linen, and purple, and scarlet, and decked with gold, and precious stones, and pearls!
verses.modern: They will cry out: "How terrible, how terrible — that great city, dressed in fine linen, purple, and scarlet, and adorned with gold, precious stones, and pearls!"

verses.kjv: For in one hour so great riches is come to nought. And every shipmaster, and all the company in ships, and sailors, and as many as trade by sea, stood afar off,
verses.modern: In just one hour all that wealth has been destroyed! Every sea captain, every passenger, every sailor, and everyone who works on the sea stood far off

verses.kjv: And cried when they saw the smoke of her burning, saying, What city is like unto this great city!
verses.modern: and cried out when they saw the smoke of her burning: "What city was ever like this great city?"

verses.kjv: And they cast dust on their heads, and cried, weeping and wailing, saying, Alas, alas, that great city, wherein were made rich all that had ships in the sea by reason of her costliness! for in one hour is she made desolate.
verses.modern: They threw dust on their heads and cried out, weeping and mourning: "How terrible, how terrible — that great city, where all who had ships at sea grew rich from her wealth! In just one hour she has been destroyed!"

verses.kjv: Rejoice over her, thou heaven, and ye holy apostles and prophets; for God hath avenged you on her.
verses.modern: Rejoice over her, O heaven, and you holy apostles and prophets! God has judged her for the way she treated you.

verses.kjv: And a mighty angel took up a stone like a great millstone, and cast it into the sea, saying, Thus with violence shall that great city Babylon be thrown down, and shall be found no more at all.
verses.modern: Then a mighty angel picked up a boulder the size of a large millstone and threw it into the sea, saying: "With this same violence the great city of Babylon will be thrown down, never to be found again."

verses.kjv: And the voice of harpers, and musicians, and of pipers, and trumpeters, shall be heard no more at all in thee; and no craftsman, of whatsoever craft he be, shall be found any more in thee; and the sound of a millstone shall be heard no more at all in thee;
verses.modern: The music of harpists and musicians, flute players and trumpeters, will never be heard in you again. No craftsman of any trade will ever be found in you again. The sound of a millstone will never be heard in you again.

verses.kjv: And the light of a candle shall shine no more at all in thee; and the voice of the bridegroom and of the bride shall be heard no more at all in thee: for thy merchants were the great men of the earth; for by thy sorceries were all nations deceived.
verses.modern: The light of a lamp will never shine in you again. The voice of a bridegroom and bride will never be heard in you again. Your merchants were the great men of the earth, and all the nations were deceived by your sorceries.

verses.kjv: And in her was found the blood of prophets, and of saints, and of all that were slain upon the earth.
verses.modern: In her was found the blood of prophets and saints — and of all who have been killed on the earth.

chapters.summary: An angel announces the fall of Babylon the great, which is become the habitation of devils and the hold of every foul spirit. A voice from heaven calls God's people to come out of her, and the merchants and kings of the earth weep and mourn over her destruction, for in one hour so great riches is come to nought. Heaven and the holy apostles and prophets rejoice, for God has avenged them on her.

verses.kjv: And after these things I heard a great voice of much people in heaven, saying, Alleluia; Salvation, and glory, and honour, and power, unto the Lord our God:
verses.modern: And after these things I heard a great voice of much people in heaven, saying, "Alleluia! Salvation, and glory, and honour, and power, to the Lord our God;

verses.kjv: For true and righteous are his judgments: for he hath judged the great whore, which did corrupt the earth with her fornication, and hath avenged the blood of his servants at her hand.
verses.modern: "His judgments are true and righteous. He has judged the great prostitute who corrupted the earth with her immorality. He has avenged the blood of His servants shed by her hand."

verses.kjv: And again they said, Alleluia. And her smoke rose up for ever and ever.
verses.modern: And again they said, "Alleluia!" And her smoke rose up for ever and ever.

verses.kjv: And the four and twenty elders and the four beasts fell down and worshipped God that sat on the throne, saying, Amen; Alleluia.
verses.modern: And the four and twenty elders and the four living creatures fell down and worshipped God Who sat on the throne, saying, "Amen, Alleluia!"

verses.kjv: And a voice came out of the throne, saying, Praise our God, all ye his servants, and ye that fear him, both small and great.
verses.modern: A voice came from the throne, saying: "Praise our God, all You His servants, you who fear him, both small and great!"

verses.kjv: And I heard as it were the voice of a great multitude, and as the voice of many waters, and as the voice of mighty thunderings, saying, Alleluia: for the Lord God omnipotent reigneth.
verses.modern: And I heard as it were the voice of a great crowd, and as the voice of many waters, and as the voice of mighty thunderings, saying, "Alleluia! For the Lord God omnipotent reigns!"

verses.kjv: Let us be glad and rejoice, and give honour to him: for the marriage of the Lamb is come, and his wife hath made herself ready.
verses.modern: "Let us be glad and rejoice and give Him glory! For the marriage of the Lamb has come, and His bride has made herself ready."

verses.kjv: And to her was granted that she should be arrayed in fine linen, clean and white: for the fine linen is the righteousness of saints.
verses.modern: She was given fine linen, bright and clean, to wear. The fine linen stands for the righteous deeds of the saints.

verses.kjv: And he saith unto me, Write, Blessed are they which are called unto the marriage supper of the Lamb. And he saith unto me, These are the true sayings of God.
verses.modern: Then the angel said to me, "Write this: Blessed are those who are invited to the marriage supper of the Lamb!" He added, "These are the true words of God."

verses.kjv: And I fell at his feet to worship him. And he said unto me, See thou do it not: I am thy fellowservant, and of thy brethren that have the testimony of Jesus: worship God: for the testimony of Jesus is the spirit of prophecy.
verses.modern: I fell at His feet to worship Him, but He said to me, "Do not do that! I am a fellow servant with You and Your brothers who hold the testimony of Jesus. Worship God! For the testimony of Jesus is the spirit of prophecy."

verses.kjv: And I saw heaven opened, and behold a white horse; and he that sat upon him was called Faithful and True, and in righteousness he doth judge and make war.
verses.modern: I saw heaven standing open, and there before me was a white horse. Its rider is called Faithful and True. He judges and makes war in righteousness.

verses.kjv: His eyes were as a flame of fire, and on his head were many crowns; and he had a name written, that no man knew, but he himself.
verses.modern: His eyes are like blazing fire, and on His head are many crowns. He has a name written on Him that no one knows but himself.

verses.kjv: And he was clothed with a vesture dipped in blood: and his name is called The Word of God.
verses.modern: He is dressed in clothing dipped in blood, and His name is called The Word of God.

verses.kjv: And the armies which were in heaven followed him upon white horses, clothed in fine linen, white and clean.
verses.modern: The armies of heaven followed Him on white horses, dressed in fine linen, white and clean.

verses.kjv: And out of his mouth goeth a sharp sword, that with it he should smite the nations: and he shall rule them with a rod of iron: and he treadeth the winepress of the fierceness and wrath of Almighty God.
verses.modern: Out of His mouth comes a sharp sword to strike down the nations. He will rule them with a rod of iron. He treads the winepress of the fierce wrath of God Almighty.

verses.kjv: And he hath on his vesture and on his thigh a name written, KING OF KINGS, AND LORD OF LORDS.
verses.modern: On His clothing and on His thigh is written: KING OF KINGS AND LORD OF LORDS.

verses.kjv: And I saw an angel standing in the sun; and he cried with a loud voice, saying to all the fowls that fly in the midst of heaven, Come and gather yourselves together unto the supper of the great God;
verses.modern: I saw an angel standing in the sun. He cried out in a loud voice to all the birds flying in midair, "Come! Gather together for the great supper of God."

verses.kjv: That ye may eat the flesh of kings, and the flesh of captains, and the flesh of mighty men, and the flesh of horses, and of them that sit on them, and the flesh of all men, both free and bond, both small and great.
verses.modern: "Come and eat the flesh of kings, generals, and mighty men — the flesh of horses and their riders — the flesh of all people, free and slave, small and great."

verses.kjv: And I saw the beast, and the kings of the earth, and their armies, gathered together to make war against him that sat on the horse, and against his army.
verses.modern: I saw the beast and the kings of the earth and their armies gathered together to wage war against the rider on the horse and His army.

verses.kjv: And the beast was taken, and with him the false prophet that wrought miracles before him, with which he deceived them that had received the mark of the beast, and them that worshipped his image. These both were cast alive into a lake of fire burning with brimstone.
verses.modern: The beast was captured, and with him the false prophet who had performed signs on his behalf — the signs by which he had deceived those who received the mark of the beast and worshiped his image. The two of them were thrown alive into the lake of fire burning with brimstone.

verses.kjv: And the remnant were slain with the sword of him that sat upon the horse, which sword proceeded out of his mouth: and all the fowls were filled with their flesh.
verses.modern: The rest were killed by the sword that came out of the mouth of the rider on the horse. All the birds gorged themselves on their flesh.

chapters.summary: A great multitude in heaven cries "Alleluia!" and the marriage supper of the Lamb is come. John sees heaven opened, and One called Faithful and True rides forth on a white horse — His name is THE WORD OF GOD, and on His vesture and thigh is written KING OF KINGS, AND LORD OF LORDS. The beast and the false prophet are cast alive into the lake of fire burning with brimstone.

verses.kjv: And I saw an angel come down from heaven, having the key of the bottomless pit and a great chain in his hand.
verses.modern: I saw an angel come down from heaven. He held the key to the bottomless pit and a great chain in His hand.

verses.kjv: And he laid hold on the dragon, that old serpent, which is the Devil, and Satan, and bound him a thousand years,
verses.modern: He seized the dragon — that ancient serpent, who is the Devil and Satan — and bound him for a thousand years.

verses.kjv: And cast him into the bottomless pit, and shut him up, and set a seal upon him, that he should deceive the nations no more, till the thousand years should be fulfilled: and after that he must be loosed a little season.
verses.modern: He threw him into the bottomless pit, shut it, and sealed it over him so he could no longer deceive the nations. This would last until the thousand years were complete. After that, he must be released for a short time.

verses.kjv: And I saw thrones, and they sat upon them, and judgment was given unto them: and I saw the souls of them that were beheaded for the witness of Jesus, and for the word of God, and which had not worshipped the beast, neither his image, neither had received his mark upon their foreheads, or in their hands; and they lived and reigned with Christ a thousand years.
verses.modern: I saw thrones, and those who sat on them were given authority to judge. I saw the souls of those who had been beheaded for their witness to Jesus and for the word of God. They had not worshipped the beast or his image, and had not received his mark on their foreheads or hands. They came to life and reigned with Christ for a thousand years.

verses.kjv: But the rest of the dead lived not again until the thousand years were finished. This is the first resurrection.
verses.modern: The rest of the dead did not come to life until the thousand years were ended. This is the first resurrection.

verses.kjv: Blessed and holy is he that hath part in the first resurrection: on such the second death hath no power, but they shall be priests of God and of Christ, and shall reign with him a thousand years.
verses.modern: Blessed and holy is everyone who has part in the first resurrection. The second death has no power over them. They will be priests of God and of Christ, and will reign with Him a thousand years.

verses.kjv: And when the thousand years are expired, Satan shall be loosed out of his prison,
verses.modern: When the thousand years are over, Satan will be released from his prison.

verses.kjv: And shall go out to deceive the nations which are in the four quarters of the earth, Gog and Magog, to gather them together to battle: the number of whom is as the sand of the sea.
verses.modern: He will go out to deceive the nations at the four corners of the earth — Gog and Magog — and gather them for battle. Their number will be like the sand of the sea.

verses.kjv: And they went up on the breadth of the earth, and compassed the camp of the saints about, and the beloved city: and fire came down from God out of heaven, and devoured them.
verses.modern: They spread out across the earth and surrounded the camp of God's people and the beloved city. But fire came down from God out of heaven and consumed them.

verses.kjv: And the devil that deceived them was cast into the lake of fire and brimstone, where the beast and the false prophet are, and shall be tormented day and night for ever and ever.
verses.modern: The devil who had deceived them was thrown into the lake of fire and brimstone, where the beast and the false prophet already were. They will be tormented day and night forever and ever.

verses.kjv: And I saw a great white throne, and him that sat on it, from whose face the earth and the heaven fled away; and there was found no place for them.
verses.modern: I saw a great white throne and the One who sat on it. The earth and the heaven fled from His face, and no place was found for them.

verses.kjv: And I saw the dead, small and great, stand before God; and the books were opened: and another book was opened, which is the book of life: and the dead were judged out of those things which were written in the books, according to their works.
verses.modern: I saw the dead, both small and great, standing before God. The books were opened, and another book was opened — the book of life. The dead were judged according to what was written in the books, according to their works.

verses.kjv: And the sea gave up the dead which were in it; and death and hell delivered up the dead which were in them: and they were judged every man according to their works.
verses.modern: The sea gave up its dead. Death and hell gave up the dead that were in them. Every person was judged according to their works.

verses.kjv: And death and hell were cast into the lake of fire. This is the second death.
verses.modern: Then death and hell were thrown into the lake of fire. This is the second death.

verses.kjv: And whosoever was not found written in the book of life was cast into the lake of fire.
verses.modern: Anyone whose name was not found written in the book of life was thrown into the lake of fire.

chapters.summary: An angel binds Satan for a thousand years and casts him into the bottomless pit, and the saints reign with Christ for the thousand years. After the thousand years Satan is loosed, deceives the nations, and gathers them to battle, but fire comes down from God out of heaven and devours them, and the devil is cast into the lake of fire. John sees the great white throne judgment: the dead are judged according to their works, and whosoever is not found written in the book of life is cast into the lake of fire.

verses.kjv: And I saw a new heaven and a new earth: for the first heaven and the first earth were passed away; and there was no more sea.
verses.modern: I saw a new heaven and a new earth. The first heaven and the first earth had passed away, and the sea was no more.

verses.kjv: And I John saw the holy city, new Jerusalem, coming down from God out of heaven, prepared as a bride adorned for her husband.
verses.modern: I, John, saw the holy city — the new Jerusalem — coming down out of heaven from God, prepared as a bride adorned for her husband.

verses.kjv: And I heard a great voice out of heaven saying, Behold, the tabernacle of God is with men, and he will dwell with them, and they shall be his people, and God himself shall be with them, and be their God.
verses.modern: I heard a loud voice from heaven say: "The tabernacle of God is now with men. He will live with them, and they will be His people. God Himself will be with them and be their God."

verses.kjv: And God shall wipe away all tears from their eyes; and there shall be no more death, neither sorrow, nor crying, neither shall there be any more pain: for the former things are passed away.
verses.modern: God will wipe away every tear from their eyes. There will be no more death, sorrow, crying, or pain. All those former things will have passed away.

verses.kjv: And he that sat upon the throne said, Behold, I make all things new. And he said unto me, Write: for these words are true and faithful.
verses.modern: He who sat on the throne said, "I am making all things new." He said to me, "Write this down, for these words are true and faithful."

verses.kjv: And he said unto me, It is done. I am Alpha and Omega, the beginning and the end. I will give unto him that is athirst of the fountain of the water of life freely.
verses.modern: He said to me, "It is done. I am Alpha and Omega, the beginning and the end. To anyone who is thirsty, I will give freely from the fountain of the water of life."

verses.kjv: He that overcometh shall inherit all things; and I will be his God, and he shall be my son.
verses.modern: The one who overcomes will inherit all things. I will be his God, and He will be My son.

verses.kjv: But the fearful, and unbelieving, and the abominable, and murderers, and whoremongers, and sorcerers, and idolaters, and all liars, shall have their part in the lake which burneth with fire and brimstone: which is the second death.
verses.modern: But the cowardly, the unbelieving, the abominable, murderers, the sexually immoral, sorcerers, idolaters, and all liars — their part will be in the lake that burns with fire and brimstone. This is the second death.

verses.kjv: And there came unto me one of the seven angels which had the seven vials full of the seven last plagues, and talked with me, saying, Come hither, I will shew thee the bride, the Lamb's wife.
verses.modern: One of the seven angels who had the seven bowls full of the seven last plagues came and spoke to me, saying, "Come, I will show you the bride, the wife of the Lamb."

verses.kjv: And he carried me away in the spirit to a great and high mountain, and shewed me that great city, the holy Jerusalem, descending out of heaven from God,
verses.modern: He carried me away in the Spirit to a great and high mountain and showed me the great city, the holy Jerusalem, descending out of heaven from God.

verses.kjv: Having the glory of God: and her light was like unto a stone most precious, even like a jasper stone, clear as crystal;
verses.modern: It shone with the glory of God. Its light was like that of a most precious stone — like a jasper, clear as crystal.

verses.kjv: And had a wall great and high, and had twelve gates, and at the gates twelve angels, and names written thereon, which are the names of the twelve tribes of the children of Israel:
verses.modern: It had a great and high wall with twelve gates. At the gates were twelve angels, and the names of the twelve tribes of the children of Israel were written on the gates.

verses.kjv: On the east three gates; on the north three gates; on the south three gates; and on the west three gates.
verses.modern: On the east were three gates, on the north three gates, on the south three gates, and on the west three gates.

verses.kjv: And the wall of the city had twelve foundations, and in them the names of the twelve apostles of the Lamb.
verses.modern: The wall of the city had twelve foundations, and on them were the names of the twelve apostles of the Lamb.

verses.kjv: And he that talked with me had a golden reed to measure the city, and the gates thereof, and the wall thereof.
verses.modern: The angel who spoke with me had a golden measuring rod to measure the city, its gates, and its wall.

verses.kjv: And the city lieth foursquare, and the length is as large as the breadth: and he measured the city with the reed, twelve thousand furlongs. The length and the breadth and the height of it are equal.
verses.modern: The city was laid out as a square — its length the same as its width. He measured the city with the rod: twelve thousand furlongs. Its length, width, and height were all equal.

verses.kjv: And he measured the wall thereof, an hundred and forty and four cubits, according to the measure of a man, that is, of the angel.
verses.modern: He measured the wall as well: one hundred and forty-four cubits, by human measurement, which the angel used.

verses.kjv: And the building of the wall of it was of jasper: and the city was pure gold, like unto clear glass.
verses.modern: The wall was built of jasper, and the city itself was pure gold, clear as glass.

verses.kjv: And the foundations of the wall of the city were garnished with all manner of precious stones. The first foundation was jasper; the second, sapphire; the third, a chalcedony; the fourth, an emerald;
verses.modern: The foundations of the city wall were decorated with every kind of precious stone. The first foundation was jasper, the second sapphire, the third chalcedony, the fourth emerald,

verses.kjv: The fifth, sardonyx; the sixth, sardius; the seventh, chrysolyte; the eighth, beryl; the ninth, a topaz; the tenth, a chrysoprasus; the eleventh, a jacinth; the twelfth, an amethyst.
verses.modern: the fifth sardonyx, the sixth sardius, the seventh chrysolyte, the eighth beryl, the ninth topaz, the tenth chrysoprasus, the eleventh jacinth, the twelfth amethyst.

verses.kjv: And the twelve gates were twelve pearls; every several gate was of one pearl: and the street of the city was pure gold, as it were transparent glass.
verses.modern: The twelve gates were twelve pearls — each gate made from a single pearl. The main street of the city was pure gold, transparent as glass.

verses.kjv: And I saw no temple therein: for the Lord God Almighty and the Lamb are the temple of it.
verses.modern: I saw no temple in the city, for the Lord God Almighty and the Lamb are its temple.

verses.kjv: And the city had no need of the sun, neither of the moon, to shine in it: for the glory of God did lighten it, and the Lamb is the light thereof.
verses.modern: The city has no need of the sun or moon to shine on it, for the glory of God gives it light, and the Lamb is its lamp.

verses.kjv: And the nations of them which are saved shall walk in the light of it: and the kings of the earth do bring their glory and honour into it.
verses.modern: The nations of those who are saved will walk in its light, and the kings of the earth will bring their glory and honor into it.

verses.kjv: And the gates of it shall not be shut at all by day: for there shall be no night there.
verses.modern: Its gates will never be shut by day — and there will be no night there.

verses.kjv: And they shall bring the glory and honour of the nations into it.
verses.modern: The glory and honor of the nations will be brought into it.

verses.kjv: And there shall in no wise enter into it any thing that defileth, neither whatsoever worketh abomination, or maketh a lie: but they which are written in the Lamb's book of life.
verses.modern: Nothing that defiles will ever enter it, nor anyone who does what is shameful or false. Only those who are written in the Lamb's book of life will enter.

chapters.summary: John sees a new heaven and a new earth, and the holy city, new Jerusalem, coming down from God out of heaven, prepared as a bride adorned for her husband. God shall dwell with His people, and He shall wipe away all tears from their eyes — there shall be no more death, neither sorrow, nor crying, nor pain. The city has no need of the sun or the moon, for the glory of God lightens it, and the Lamb is the light thereof.

verses.kjv: And he shewed me a pure river of water of life, clear as crystal, proceeding out of the throne of God and of the Lamb.
verses.modern: He showed me a pure river of the water of life, clear as crystal, flowing from the throne of God and of the Lamb.

verses.kjv: In the midst of the street of it, and on either side of the river, was there the tree of life, which bare twelve manner of fruits, and yielded her fruit every month: and the leaves of the tree were for the healing of the nations.
verses.modern: In the middle of the main street of the city, and on both sides of the river, stood the tree of life. It bears twelve kinds of fruit, yielding its fruit every month. The leaves of the tree are for the healing of the nations.

verses.kjv: And there shall be no more curse: but the throne of God and of the Lamb shall be in it; and his servants shall serve him:
verses.modern: There will be no more curse. The throne of God and of the Lamb will be in the city, and His servants will serve him.

verses.kjv: And they shall see his face; and his name shall be in their foreheads.
verses.modern: They will see His face, and His name will be on their foreheads.

verses.kjv: And there shall be no night there; and they need no candle, neither light of the sun; for the Lord God giveth them light: and they shall reign for ever and ever.
verses.modern: There will be no night there. They will need no lamp or sunlight, for the Lord God will give them light. They will reign forever and ever.

verses.kjv: And he said unto me, These sayings are faithful and true: and the Lord God of the holy prophets sent his angel to shew unto his servants the things which must shortly be done.
verses.modern: He said to me, "These words are faithful and true. The Lord God of the holy prophets sent His angel to show His servants the things that must soon take place."

verses.kjv: Behold, I come quickly: blessed is he that keepeth the sayings of the prophecy of this book.
verses.modern: "I am coming soon. Blessed is the one who keeps the words of the prophecy of this book."

verses.kjv: And I John saw these things, and heard them. And when I had heard and seen, I fell down to worship before the feet of the angel which shewed me these things.
verses.modern: I, John, saw and heard these things. When I had heard and seen them, I fell down to worship at the feet of the angel who had shown them to me.

verses.kjv: Then saith he unto me, See thou do it not: for I am thy fellowservant, and of thy brethren the prophets, and of them which keep the sayings of this book: worship God.
verses.modern: He said to me, "Do not do that. I am a fellow servant with You and Your brothers the prophets, and with those who keep the words of this book. Worship God."

verses.kjv: And he saith unto me, Seal not the sayings of the prophecy of this book: for the time is at hand.
verses.modern: He said to me, "Do not seal up the words of the prophecy of this book, for the time is near."

verses.kjv: He that is unjust, let him be unjust still: and he which is filthy, let him be filthy still: and he that is righteous, let him be righteous still: and he that is holy, let him be holy still.
verses.modern: Let the one who does wrong keep doing wrong. Let the one who is filthy stay filthy. Let the one who is righteous keep doing right. Let the one who is holy continue to be holy.

verses.kjv: And, behold, I come quickly; and my reward is with me, to give every man according as his work shall be.
verses.modern: "I am coming soon, and My reward is with Me. I will give to each person according to what they have done."

verses.kjv: I am Alpha and Omega, the beginning and the end, the first and the last.
verses.modern: "I am Alpha and Omega, the beginning and the end, the first and the last."

verses.kjv: Blessed are they that do his commandments, that they may have right to the tree of life, and may enter in through the gates into the city.
verses.modern: Blessed are those who keep His commandments. They will have the right to the tree of life and may enter the city through the gates.

verses.kjv: For without are dogs, and sorcerers, and whoremongers, and murderers, and idolaters, and whosoever loveth and maketh a lie.
verses.modern: Outside are the dogs, sorcerers, the sexually immoral, murderers, idolaters, and everyone who loves and practices falsehood.

verses.kjv: I Jesus have sent mine angel to testify unto you these things in the churches. I am the root and the offspring of David, and the bright and morning star.
verses.modern: "I, Jesus, have sent My angel to testify these things to You for the churches. I am the root and the offspring of David — the bright and morning star."

verses.kjv: And the Spirit and the bride say, Come. And let him that heareth say, Come. And let him that is athirst come. And whosoever will, let him take the water of life freely.
verses.modern: The Spirit and the bride say, "Come." Let the one who hears say, "Come." Let the one who is thirsty come. Let anyone who desires it take the water of life freely.

verses.kjv: For I testify unto every man that heareth the words of the prophecy of this book, If any man shall add unto these things, God shall add unto him the plagues that are written in this book:
verses.modern: I warn everyone who hears the words of the prophecy of this book: if anyone adds to these things, God will add to Him the plagues that are written in this book.

verses.kjv: And if any man shall take away from the words of the book of this prophecy, God shall take away his part out of the book of life, and out of the holy city, and from the things which are written in this book.
verses.modern: If anyone takes away from the words of the book of this prophecy, God will take away His part from the book of life, from the holy city, and from the things written in this book.

verses.kjv: He which testifieth these things saith, Surely I come quickly. Amen. Even so, come, Lord Jesus.
verses.modern: He who testifies to these things says, "Surely I am coming soon." Amen. Come, Lord Jesus.

verses.kjv: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all. Amen.
verses.modern: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with You all. Amen.

chapters.summary: John sees the pure river of the water of life proceeding out of the throne of God and of the Lamb, and the tree of life bearing twelve manner of fruits, whose leaves are for the healing of the nations. Christ declares, "I come quickly," and the Spirit and the bride say, "Come." A solemn warning is given: if any man adds to or takes away from the words of this prophecy, God shall add to him the plagues written in this book.
